title: Matta 1:1
content: 1 Tarihin da aka rubuta game da asalin Yesu Kiristi ɗan Dawuda, ɗan Ibrahim.

title: Matta 1:2
content: 2 Ibrahim ya haifi Ishaku, Ishaku ya haifi Yaƙub, Yaƙub ya haifi Yahuda da ’yan’uwansa,

title: Matta 1:3
content: 3 Yahuda ya haifi Ferez da Zera, waɗanda Tamar ce mahaifiyarsu; Ferez ya haifi Hezron, Hezron ya haifi Ram,

title: Matta 1:4
content: 4 Ram ya haifi Amminadab, Amminadab ya haifi Nashon, Nashon ya haifi Salmon,

title: Matta 1:5
content: 5 Salmon ya haifi Bowaz, wanda Rahab ce mahaifiyarsa, Bowaz ya haifi Obed, wanda Rut ce mahaifiyarsa, Obed ya haifi Yesse,

title: Matta 1:6
content: 6 Yesse kuwa ya haifi Sarki Dawuda. Dawuda ya haifi Solomon, wanda matar Uriya ce mahaifiyarsa.

title: Matta 1:7
content: 7 Solomon ya haifi Rehobowam, Rehobowam ya haifi Abiya, Abiya ya haifi Asa,

title: Matta 1:8
content: 8 Asa ya haifi Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat ya haifi Yehoram, Yehoram ya haifi Azariya,

title: Matta 1:9
content: 9 Azariya ya haifi Yotam, Yotam ya haifi Ahaz, Ahaz ya haifi Hezekiya,

title: Matta 1:10
content: 10 Hezekiya ya haifi Manasse, Manasse ya haifi Amon, Amon ya haifi Yosiya,

title: Matta 1:11
content: 11 Yosiya kuma ya haifi Yekoniya da ’yan’uwansa a lokacin da aka kwashe su zuwa bauta a Babilon.

title: Matta 1:12
content: 12 Bayan an kwashe su zuwa bauta a Babilon. Yekoniya ya haifi Sheyaltiyel, Sheyaltiyel ya haifi Zerubbabel,

title: Matta 1:13
content: 13 Zerubbabel ya haifi Abiyud, Abiyud ya haifi Eliyakim, Eliyakim ya haifi Azor,

title: Matta 1:14
content: 14 Azor ya haifi Zadok, Zadok ya haifi Akim, Akim kuma ya haifi Eliyud,

title: Matta 1:15
content: 15 Eliyud ya haifi Eleyazar, Eleyazar ya haifi Mattan, Mattan ya haifi Yaƙub,

title: Matta 1:16
content: 16 Yaƙub ya haifi Yusuf, mijin Maryamu, wadda ta haifi Yesu, wanda ake kira Kiristi.

title: Matta 1:17
content: 17 Ta haka akwai zuriya goma sha huɗu ke nan duka-duka daga lokacin Ibrahim zuwa lokacin Dawuda, goma sha huɗu kuma daga Dawuda zuwa bauta a Babilon, goma sha huɗu kuma daga bauta a Babilon zuwa Kiristi.

title: Matta 1:18
content: 18 Ga yadda haihuwar Yesu Kiristi ta kasance. An yi alkawarin auren mahaifiyarsa Maryamu, ga Yusuf. Amma tun kafin su zama miji da mata, sai aka tarar Maryamu tana da ciki, ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki.

title: Matta 1:19
content: 19 Yusuf mijinta, da yake shi mai adalci ne, bai so yă ba ta kunya, yă tone mata asiri a fili ba, sai ya yi tunani yă sake ta a ɓoye.

title: Matta 1:20
content: 20 Amma yana cikin wannan tunani, sai wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana masa cikin mafarki ya ce, “Yusuf ɗan Dawuda, kada ka ji tsoron ɗaukan Maryamu zuwa gidanka a matsayin matarka, gama cikin nan nata, daga wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ne.

title: Matta 1:21
content: 21 Za tă haifi ɗa, za ka kuma sa masa suna Yesu, gama shi ne zai ceci mutanensa daga zunubansu.”

title: Matta 1:22
content: 22 Duk wannan ya faru ne, don a cika abin da Ubangiji ya faɗi ta bakin annabin cewa,

title: Matta 1:23
content: 23 “Ga shi budurwa za tă yi ciki, za tă haifi ɗa, kuma za a kira shi Immanuwel” (wanda yake nufin “Allah tare da mu”).

title: Matta 1:24
content: 24 Da Yusuf ya farka daga barci, sai ya bi umarnin mala’ikan Ubangiji, ya ɗauki Maryamu zuwa gida a matsayin matarsa.

title: Matta 1:25
content: 25 Amma bai kwana da ita ba, sai bayan da ta haifi ɗan. Ya kuwa sa masa suna Yesu.

title: Matta 2:1
content: 1 Bayan an haifi Yesu a Betlehem, a Yahudiya, a zamanin Sarki Hiridus, sai waɗansu Masana, daga gabas suka zo Urushalima

title: Matta 2:2
content: 2 suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Ina shi wanda aka haifa sarkin Yahudawa? Gama mun ga tauraronsa a gabas mun kuwa zo ne domin mu yi masa sujada.”

title: Matta 2:3
content: 3 Da Sarki Hiridus ya ji wannan, sai hankalinsa ya tashi haka ma na dukan Urushalima.

title: Matta 2:4
content: 4 Bayan ya kira dukan manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki na mutane wuri ɗaya, sai ya tambaye su inda za a haifi Kiristi.

title: Matta 2:5
content: 5 Suka amsa suka ce, “A Betlehem ne, cikin Yahudiya, gama haka annabin ya rubuta.

title: Matta 2:6
content: 6 “ ‘Amma ke Betlehem, a cikin ƙasar Yahuda, ba ke ce mafi ƙanƙanta a cikin masu mulki a Yahuda ba, gama daga cikinki mai mulki zai zo, wanda zai zama makiyayin mutanena Isra’ila.’”

title: Matta 2:7
content: 7 Sai Hiridus ya kira Masanan nan a ɓoye, yă gano daga wurinsu daidai lokacin da tauraron ya bayyana.

title: Matta 2:8
content: 8 Sai ya aike su Betlehem ya ce, “Ku je ku binciko a hankali game da yaron nan. Da kun same shi, sai ku kawo mini labari nan da nan, domin ni ma in je in yi masa sujada.”

title: Matta 2:9
content: 9 Bayan sun saurari sarki, sai suka kama hanyarsu, tauraron da suka gani a gabas kuwa yana tafe a gabansu, sai da ya kai inda yaron yake.

title: Matta 2:10
content: 10 Da suka ga tauraron, sai suka yi farin ciki ƙwarai.

title: Matta 2:11
content: 11 Suka shiga gidan, suka kuwa ga yaron tare da mahaifiyarsa Maryamu. Suka durƙusa har ƙasa, suka yi masa sujada. Sa’an nan suka kunce dukiyarsu, suka miƙa masa kyautai na zinariya da na turare da na mur.

title: Matta 2:12
content: 12 Bayan an gargaɗe su cikin mafarki kada su koma wurin Hiridus, sai suka koma ƙasarsu ta wata hanya dabam.

title: Matta 2:13
content: 13 Bayan sun tafi, sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Yusuf a mafarki ya ce, “Tashi, ka ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa, ku gudu zuwa Masar. Ku zauna a can sai na gaya muku, gama Hiridus zai nemi yaron don yă kashe.”

title: Matta 2:14
content: 14 Sai Yusuf ya tashi, ya ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa da dad dare suka tafi Masar,

title: Matta 2:15
content: 15 inda ya zauna har sai da Hiridus ya mutu. Ta haka kuwa aka cika abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa ta bakin annabin cewa, “Daga Masar na kira ɗana.”

title: Matta 2:16
content: 16 Da Hiridus ya gane cewa Masanan nan sun yi masa wayo, sai ya husata ƙwarai, ya yi umarni cewa a karkashe dukan ’yan yara maza da suke a Betlehem da kewayenta, daga masu shekara biyu zuwa ƙasa, bisa ga lokacin da ya sami labarin daga Masanan nan.

title: Matta 2:17
content: 17 Sai abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Irmiya ya cika, cewa,

title: Matta 2:18
content: 18 “An ji murya a Rama, tana kuka da makoki mai tsanani, Rahila ce take kuka domin ’ya’yanta, an kāsa ta’azantar da ita, don ba su.”

title: Matta 2:19
content: 19 Bayan Hiridus ya mutu, sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Yusuf a mafarki a Masar,

title: Matta 2:20
content: 20 ya ce, “Tashi, ka ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa ku tafi ƙasar Isra’ila, domin waɗanda suke neman ran yaron sun mutu.”

title: Matta 2:21
content: 21 Sai ya tashi, ya ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa suka tafi ƙasar Isra’ila.

title: Matta 2:22
content: 22 Amma da ya ji Arkelawus ne yake mulki a Yahudiya a matsayin wanda ya gāji mahaifinsa Hiridus, sai ya ji tsoron zuwa can. Bayan an gargaɗe shi a mafarki, sai ya ratse zuwa gundumar Galili,

title: Matta 2:23
content: 23 ya je ya zauna a wani garin da ake kira Nazaret. Ta haka aka cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabawa cewa, “Za a ce da shi Banazare.”

title: Matta 3:1
content: 1 A waɗancan kwanaki, Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo, yana wa’azi a Hamadan Yahudiya

title: Matta 3:2
content: 2 yana cewa, “Ku tuba, gama mulkin sama ya yi kusa.”

title: Matta 3:3
content: 3 Wannan shi ne wanda aka yi maganarsa ta wurin annabi Ishaya cewa, “Ga murya mai kira a hamada tana cewa, ‘Ku shirya wa Ubangiji hanya, ku miƙe hanyoyi dominsa.’ ”

title: Matta 3:4
content: 4 Tufafin Yohanna kuwa an yi su da gashin raƙumi ne, yana kuma daure da ɗamara ta fata. Abincinsa kuwa fāri ne da zumar jeji.

title: Matta 3:5
content: 5 Mutane suka zo wurinsa daga Urushalima da dukan Yahudiya da kuma dukan yankin Urdun.

title: Matta 3:6
content: 6 Suna furta zunubansu, ya kuma yi musu baftisma a Kogin Urdun.

title: Matta 3:7
content: 7 Amma da Yohanna ya ga Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa da yawa suna zuwa inda yake yin baftisma, sai ya ce musu, “Ku macizai! Wa ya gargaɗe ku ku guje wa fushin nan mai zuwa?

title: Matta 3:8
content: 8 Ku yi ayyukan da suka dace da tuba.

title: Matta 3:9
content: 9 Kada ma ku yi tunani a ranku cewa, ‘Ai, Ibrahim ne mahaifinmu.’ Ina gaya muku cewa Allah zai iya tā da ’ya’ya wa Ibrahim daga cikin duwatsun nan.

title: Matta 3:10
content: 10 An riga an sa bakin gatari a gindin itatuwa, kuma duk itacen da bai ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau ba, za a sare shi a jefa cikin wuta.

title: Matta 3:11
content: 11 “Ina muku baftisma da ruwa domin tuba. Amma wani yana zuwa a bayana wanda ya fi ni iko, wanda ko takalmansa ma ban isa in ɗauka ba. Zai yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da kuma wuta.

title: Matta 3:12
content: 12 Yana riƙe da matankaɗinsa, zai tankaɗe hatsinsa, yă kuma tattara alkamarsa a cikin rumbu, amma zai ƙone yayin da wutar da ba a iya kashewa.”

title: Matta 3:13
content: 13 Sai Yesu ya zo daga Galili, ya je Urdun don Yohanna yă yi masa baftisma.

title: Matta 3:14
content: 14 Amma Yohanna ya so yă hana shi, yana cewa, “Ina bukata ka yi mini baftisma, yaya kake zuwa wurina?”

title: Matta 3:15
content: 15 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Bari yă zama haka yanzu; ya dace mu yi haka don mu cika dukan adalci.” Sa’an nan Yohanna ya yarda.

title: Matta 3:16
content: 16 Nan da nan da aka yi wa Yesu baftisma, sai ya fito daga ruwa. A wannan lokaci sama ya buɗe, sai ya ga Ruhun Allah yana saukowa kamar kurciya ya kuwa sauka a kansa.

title: Matta 3:17
content: 17 Sai murya daga sama ta ce, “Wannan shi ne Ɗana wanda nake ƙauna; wanda kuma nake jin daɗinsa ƙwarai.”

title: Matta 4:1
content: 1 Sa’an nan Ruhu ya kai Yesu cikin hamada don Iblis yă gwada shi.

title: Matta 4:2
content: 2 Bayan ya yi azumi yini arba’in da kuma dare arba’in, sai ya ji yunwa.

title: Matta 4:3
content: 3 Sai mai gwajin ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka ce wa duwatsun nan su zama burodi.”

title: Matta 4:4
content: 4 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A rubuce yake cewa, ‘Ba da abinci kaɗai mutum yake rayuwa ba, sai dai da kowace kalmar da take fitowa daga bakin Allah.’”

title: Matta 4:5
content: 5 Sai Iblis ya kai shi birni mai tsarki, ya kai shi can wuri mafi tsayi duka na haikali.

title: Matta 4:6
content: 6 Ya ce, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, yi tsalle ka sauka ƙasa. Gama a rubuce yake, “ ‘Zai umarci mala’ikunsa game da kai, za su tallafe ka da hannuwansu, don kada ka buga ƙafarka a kan dutse.’”

title: Matta 4:7
content: 7 Yesu ya amsa masa ya ce, “A rubuce yake kuma cewa, ‘Kada ka gwada Ubangiji Allahnka.’”

title: Matta 4:8
content: 8 Har wa yau, Iblis ya kai shi bisa wani dutse mai tsawo sosai, ya nunnuna masa dukan mulkokin duniya da darajarsu.

title: Matta 4:9
content: 9 Ya ce, “Zan ba ka dukan wannan, in za ka durƙusa ka yi mini sujada.”

title: Matta 4:10
content: 10 Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Rabu da ni, Shaiɗan! Gama a rubuce yake, ‘Yi wa Ubangiji Allahnka sujada, shi kaɗai kuma za ka bauta wa.’”

title: Matta 4:11
content: 11 Sa’an nan Iblis ya bar shi, mala’iku kuwa suka zo suka yi masa hidima.

title: Matta 4:12
content: 12 Da Yesu ya ji labari cewa an kulle Yohanna a kurkuku, sai ya koma zuwa Galili.

title: Matta 4:13
content: 13 Ya bar Nazaret, ya je ya zauna a Kafarnahum, wadda take a bakin tafki wajen Zebulun da Naftali

title: Matta 4:14
content: 14 don a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Ishaya cewa,

title: Matta 4:15
content: 15 “Ƙasar Zebulun da ƙasar Naftali, da kuke a hanyar zuwa tekun Galili, a ƙetaren Urdun, wannan yankin Galili ta Al’ummai,

title: Matta 4:16
content: 16 mutanen da suke zama cikin duhu sun ga babban haske; haske kuma ya haskaka a kan waɗanda suke zama a inuwar mutuwa.”

title: Matta 4:17
content: 17 Tun daga wannan lokaci, Yesu ya fara wa’azi yana cewa, “Ku tuba, gama mulkin sama ya yi kusa.”

title: Matta 4:18
content: 18 Da Yesu yana kan tafiya a bakin Tekun Galili, sai ya ga waɗansu ’yan’uwa guda biyu, Siman wanda ake kira Bitrus da ɗan’uwansa Andarawus. Suna jefa abin kamun kifi a tafki, gama su masunta ne.

title: Matta 4:19
content: 19 Sai Yesu ya ce, “Zo, ku bi ni, ni kuwa zan mai da ku masu jan mutane zuwa wurina.”

title: Matta 4:20
content: 20 Nan da nan suka bar abin kamun kifinsu suka bi shi.

title: Matta 4:21
content: 21 Da ya ci gaba daga nan, sai ya ga waɗansu ’yan’uwa guda biyu, Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi da ɗan’uwansa Yohanna. Suna cikin jirgin ruwa tare da mahaifinsu Zebedi, suna shirya abin kamun kifinsu. Yesu ya kira su,

title: Matta 4:22
content: 22 nan take suka bar jirgin ruwan da mahaifinsu suka kuwa bi Yesu.

title: Matta 4:23
content: 23 Yesu ya zazzaga dukan Galili, yana koyarwa a cikin majami’unsu, yana wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin sama, yana kuma warkar da kowace cuta da rashin lafiyar mutane.

title: Matta 4:24
content: 24 Labarinsa ya bazu ko’ina a Suriya, mutane kuwa suka kawo masa dukan waɗanda suke fama da cututtuka iri-iri, da waɗanda suke da zafin ciwo, da masu aljanu, da waɗanda suke masu farfaɗiya, da shanyayyu, ya kuwa warkar da su.

title: Matta 4:25
content: 25 Taron mutane mai yawa daga Galili, Dekafolis, Urushalima, Yahudiya da kuma yankin hayin Urdun suka bi shi.

title: Matta 5:1
content: 1 Ganin taron mutane, sai ya hau kan gefen dutse ya zauna. Almajiransa kuwa suka zo wurinsa,

title: Matta 5:2
content: 2 sai ya fara koya musu. Yana cewa,

title: Matta 5:3
content: 3 “Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke matalauta a ruhu, gama mulkin sama nasu ne.

title: Matta 5:4
content: 4 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke makoki, gama za a yi musu ta’aziyya.

title: Matta 5:5
content: 5 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu tawali’u, gama za su gāji duniya.

title: Matta 5:6
content: 6 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke jin yunwa da ƙishirwa don gani an yi adalci, gama za a ƙosar da su.

title: Matta 5:7
content: 7 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu jinƙai, gama za a nuna musu jinƙai.

title: Matta 5:8
content: 8 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu tsabtar zuciya, gama za su ga Allah.

title: Matta 5:9
content: 9 Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu ƙulla zumunci, gama za a kira su ’ya’yan Allah.

title: Matta 5:10
content: 10 Masu albarka ne waɗanda ake tsananta musu don gani an yi adalci, gama mulkin sama nasu ne.

title: Matta 5:11
content: 11 “Masu albarka ne ku, sa’ad da mutane suke zaginku, suna tsananta muku, suna kuma faɗin kowace irin muguwar magana a kanku saboda ni.

title: Matta 5:12
content: 12 Ku yi murna ku kuma yi farin ciki, domin ladarku mai yawa ne a sama, gama haka suka tsananta wa annabawan da suka riga ku.

title: Matta 5:13
content: 13 “Ku ne gishirin duniya, amma in gishiri ya rabu da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa, yaya za a sāke mai da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa? Ba shi da sauran amfani, sai dai a zubar da shi mutane kuma su tattaka.

title: Matta 5:14
content: 14 “Ku ne hasken duniya. Birnin da yake a bisan tudu ba ya ɓoyuwa.

title: Matta 5:15
content: 15 Mutane ba sa ƙuna fitila su rufe ta da murfi. A maimako, sukan ajiye ta a kan wurin ajiye fitila, takan kuma ba da haske ga kowa a cikin gida.

title: Matta 5:16
content: 16 Haka ma, bari haskenku yă haskaka a gaban mutane, domin su ga ayyukanku masu kyau, su kuwa yabi Ubanku da yake cikin sama.

title: Matta 5:17
content: 17 “Kada ku yi tsammani na zo ne domin in kawar da Doka ko kuma Annabawa; ban zo domin in kawar da su ba ne, sai dai domin in ciccika su.

title: Matta 5:18
content: 18 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, kafin sama da ƙasa sun shuɗe, babu ko ɗan wasali, babu wani ɗigo ta kowace hanya da zai ɓace daga Dokar, sai an cika kome.

title: Matta 5:19
content: 19 Duk wanda ya karya ɗaya daga cikin mafi ƙanƙanta na umarnan nan, ya kuma koya wa waɗansu su yi haka, za a ce da shi mafi ƙanƙanta a mulkin sama. Amma duk wanda ya aikata, ya kuma koyar da waɗannan umarnai, za a kira shi mai girma a cikin mulkin sama.

title: Matta 5:20
content: 20 Gama ina faɗa muku cewa in dai adalcinku bai fi na Farisiyawa da na malaman dokoki ba, faufau, ba za ku shiga mulkin sama ba.

title: Matta 5:21
content: 21 “Kun dai ji an faɗa wa mutanen dā cewa, ‘Kada ka yi kisankai; kuma duk wanda ya yi kisankai za a hukunta shi.’

title: Matta 5:22
content: 22 Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya yi fushi da ɗan’uwansa, za a hukunta shi. Kuma duk wanda ya ce wa ɗan’uwansa ‘Raka,’ za a kai shi gaban Majalisa. Amma duk wanda ya ce, ‘Kai wawa!’ Zai kasance a hatsarin shiga jahannama ta wuta.

title: Matta 5:23
content: 23 “Saboda haka, in kana cikin ba da baikonka a kan bagade, a can kuwa ka tuna cewa ɗan’uwanka yana riƙe da kai a zuci,

title: Matta 5:24
content: 24 sai ka bar baikonka a can gaban bagade. Ka je ka shirya tukuna da ɗan’uwanka; sa’an nan ka zo ka ba da baikonka.

title: Matta 5:25
content: 25 “Ka yi hanzari ka shirya al’amura da maƙiyinka wanda yake ƙararka a kotu. Ka yi haka, tun kana tare da shi a kan hanya, in ba haka ba, zai miƙa ka ga alƙali, alƙali kuma yă miƙa ka ga ɗan sanda, mai yiwuwa kuwa a jefa ka a kurkuku.

title: Matta 5:26
content: 26 Gaskiya nake gaya maka, ba za ka fita ba, sai ka biya kobo na ƙarshe.

title: Matta 5:27
content: 27 “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Kada ka yi zina.’

title: Matta 5:28
content: 28 Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya dubi mace, sa’an nan ya yi sha’awarta a zuci, ya riga ya yi zina ke nan da ita a zuciyarsa.

title: Matta 5:29
content: 29 In idonka na dama yana sa ka yin zunubi, ƙwaƙule shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka rasa ɗaya daga cikin gaɓoɓin jikinka, da a jefa jikinka ɗungum a cikin jahannama ta wuta.

title: Matta 5:30
content: 30 In kuma hannunka na dama yana sa ka yin zunubi, yanke shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka rasa ɗaya daga cikin gaɓoɓin jikinka, da a jefa jikinka ɗungum a cikin jahannama ta wuta.

title: Matta 5:31
content: 31 “An kuma faɗa, ‘Duk wanda ya saki matarsa, dole yă ba ta takardar saki.’

title: Matta 5:32
content: 32 Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya saki matarsa in ba a kan laifin zina ba, ya sa ta zama mazinaciya ke nan, kuma duk wanda ya auri macen da mijinta ya sake, shi ma yana zina ne.

title: Matta 5:33
content: 33 “Har wa yau dai kun ji an faɗa wa mutane a dā, ‘Kada ka karya alkawarinka, sai dai ka cika alkawaran da ka yi wa Ubangiji.’

title: Matta 5:34
content: 34 Amma ina gaya muku, Kada ku yi rantsuwa sam, ko da sama, domin kursiyin Allah ne;

title: Matta 5:35
content: 35 ko da ƙasa, domin matashin ƙafafunsa ne; ko kuma da Urushalima, domin birnin Babban Sarki ne.

title: Matta 5:36
content: 36 Kada kuma ka rantse da kanka, domin ba za ka iya mai da ko gashi ɗaya yă zama fari ko baƙi ba.

title: Matta 5:37
content: 37 Abin da ya kamata ku ce kawai, shi ne, I, ko A’a. Abin da ya wuce haka kuwa daga wurin Mugun nan yake.

title: Matta 5:38
content: 38 “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Ido domin ido, haƙori kuma domin haƙori.’

title: Matta 5:39
content: 39 Amma ina gaya muku, Kada ku yi tsayayya da mugun mutum. In wani ya mare ka a kumatun dama, juya masa ɗayan ma.

title: Matta 5:40
content: 40 In kuma wani yana so yă yi ƙararka yă ƙwace rigarka, to, ba shi mayafinka ma.

title: Matta 5:41
content: 41 In wani ya tilasta ka yin tafiya mil ɗaya, to, tafi tare da shi mil biyu.

title: Matta 5:42
content: 42 Ka ba wa duk wanda ya roƙe ka abu, kada kuma ka hana wa wanda yake neman bashi daga gare ka.

title: Matta 5:43
content: 43 “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka, ka kuma ƙi abokin gābanka.’

title: Matta 5:44
content: 44 Amma ina gaya muku, ku ƙaunaci abokan gābanku kuma ku yi wa waɗanda suke tsananta muku addu’a,

title: Matta 5:45
content: 45 don ku zama ’ya’yan Ubanku na sama. Shi yakan sa ranarsa ta haskaka a kan mugaye da masu kirki; yakan kuma sako ruwan sama a bisa masu adalci da marasa adalci.

title: Matta 5:46
content: 46 In masoyarku kawai kuke ƙauna, wace lada ce gare ku? Ko masu karɓar haraji ma ba haka suke yi ba?

title: Matta 5:47
content: 47 In kuwa kuna gai da ’yan’uwanku ne kaɗai, me kuke yi fiye da waɗansu? Marasa bin Allah ma ba haka suke yi ba?

title: Matta 5:48
content: 48 Saboda haka sai ku zama cikakku, yadda Ubanku na sama yake cikakke.

title: Matta 6:1
content: 1 “Ku yi hankali kada ku nuna ‘ayyukanku na adalci’ a gaban mutane, don su gani. In kuka yi haka, ba za ku sami lada daga wurin Ubanku da yake cikin sama ba.

title: Matta 6:2
content: 2 “Saboda haka sa’ad da kake ba wa masu bukata taimako, kada ka yi shelarsa, yadda munafukai suke yi a majami’u da kuma kan tituna, don mutane su yabe su. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.

title: Matta 6:3
content: 3 Amma sa’ad da kake ba wa masu bukata taimako, kada ka yarda hannun hagunka yă ma san abin da hannun damarka yake yi,

title: Matta 6:4
content: 4 don bayarwarka ta zama a ɓoye. Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.

title: Matta 6:5
content: 5 “Sa’ad da kuma kuke addu’a, kada ku zama kamar munafukai, gama sun cika son yin addu’a a tsaye a cikin majami’u da kuma a bakin titi, don mutane su gan su. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.

title: Matta 6:6
content: 6 Amma sa’ad da kake addu’a, sai ka shiga ɗakinka, ka rufe ƙofa, ka yi addu’a ga Ubanka wanda ba a gani. Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.

title: Matta 6:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da kuma kuke addu’a, kada ku yi ta maimaita magana, kamar marasa sanin Allah, domin suna tsammani za a ji su saboda yawan maganarsu.

title: Matta 6:8
content: 8 Kada ku zama kamar su, gama Ubanku ya san abin da kuke bukata kafin ma ku roƙe shi.

title: Matta 6:9
content: 9 “To, ga yadda ya kamata ku yi addu’a. “ ‘Ubanmu wanda yake cikin sama, a tsarkake sunanka,

title: Matta 6:10
content: 10 mulkinka yă zo a aikata nufinka a duniya kamar yadda ake yi a sama.

title: Matta 6:11
content: 11 Ka ba mu yau abincin yininmu.

title: Matta 6:12
content: 12 Ka gafarta mana laifofinmu, kamar yadda mu ma muke gafarta wa masu yin mana laifi.

title: Matta 6:13
content: 13 Kada ka bari a kai mu cikin jarraba, amma ka cece mu daga mugun nan.’

title: Matta 6:14
content: 14 Gama in kuna yafe wa mutane sa’ad da suka yi muku laifi, Ubanku da yake cikin sama ma zai gafarta muku.

title: Matta 6:15
content: 15 Amma in ba kwa yafe wa mutane laifofinsu, Ubanku ma ba zai gafarta muku zunubanku ba.

title: Matta 6:16
content: 16 “Sa’ad da kuma kuna azumi, kada ku ɓata fuska, yadda munafukai suke yi. Sukan ɓata fuskokinsu domin su nuna wa mutane cewa suna azumi. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.

title: Matta 6:17
content: 17 Amma sa’ad da kana azumi, ka shafa wa kanka mai, ka wanke fuskarka,

title: Matta 6:18
content: 18 domin kada mutane su ga alama cewa kana azumi, sai dai Ubanka kaɗai wanda ba a gani; Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.

title: Matta 6:19
content: 19 “Kada ku yi wa kanku ajiyar dukiya a duniya, inda asu da tsatsa suke ɓatawa, inda kuma ɓarayi sukan fasa, su yi sata.

title: Matta 6:20
content: 20 Amma ku yi wa kanku ajiyar dukiya a sama, inda ba tsatsa da asu da za su ɓata su, inda kuma ba ɓarayin da za su fasa, su yi sata.

title: Matta 6:21
content: 21 Gama inda dukiyarka take, a nan ne fa zuciyarka za tă kasance.

title: Matta 6:22
content: 22 “Ido shi ne fitilar jiki. In idanunka suna da kyau, dukan jikinka zai cika da haske.

title: Matta 6:23
content: 23 Amma in idanunka suna da lahani, dukan jikinka ma zai cika da duhu. To, in hasken da yake a cikinka duhu ne, duhun ya wuce misali ke nan!

title: Matta 6:24
content: 24 “Ba mai iya bauta wa iyayengiji biyu. Ko dai yă ƙi ɗaya, yă ƙaunaci ɗaya, ko kuwa yă yi aminci ga ɗaya, sa’an nan yă rena ɗayan. Ba dama ku bauta wa Allah, ku kuma bauta wa kuɗi gaba ɗaya.”

title: Matta 6:25
content: 25 “Saboda haka, ina gaya muku, kada ku damu game da rayuwarku, game da abin da za ku ci, ko abin da za ku sha; ko kuma game da jikinku, game da abin da za ku sa. Ashe, rai bai fi abinci ba, jiki kuma bai fi tufafi ba?

title: Matta 6:26
content: 26 Ku dubi tsuntsayen sararin sama mana; ba sa shuki ko girbi ko ajiya a rumbuna, duk da haka, Ubanku na sama yana ciyar da su. Ashe, ba ku fi su daraja nesa ba?

title: Matta 6:27
content: 27 Wane ne a cikinku ta wurin damuwa zai iya ƙara wa rayuwarsa ko sa’a ɗaya?

title: Matta 6:28
content: 28 “Me ya sa kuke damuwa a kan riguna? Ku dubi yadda furannin jeji suke girma mana. Ba sa aiki ko saƙa.

title: Matta 6:29
content: 29 Duk da haka ina gaya muku ko Solomon cikin dukan darajarsa bai sa kayan adon da ya kai na ko ɗaya a cikinsu ba.

title: Matta 6:30
content: 30 In haka Allah yake yi wa ciyawar jeji sutura, wadda yau tana nan, gobe kuwa a jefa a cikin wuta, ba zai ma fi yi muku sutura ba, ya ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya?

title: Matta 6:31
content: 31 Don haka, kada ku damu, kuna cewa, ‘Me za mu ci?’ Ko, ‘Me za mu sha?’ Ko kuma, ‘Me za mu sa?’

title: Matta 6:32
content: 32 Gama marasa sanin Allah suna fama neman dukan waɗannan abubuwa, Ubanku na sama kuwa ya san kuna bukatarsu.

title: Matta 6:33
content: 33 Da farko dai, ku nemi mulkin Allah da kuma adalcinsa, za a kuwa ba ku dukan waɗannan abubuwa.

title: Matta 6:34
content: 34 Saboda haka kada ku damu game da gobe, gama gobe zai damu da kansa. Damuwar yau ma ta isa wahala.

title: Matta 7:1
content: 1 “Kada ku ba wa kowa laifi, don kada a ba ku laifi ku ma.

title: Matta 7:2
content: 2 Gama da irin shari’ar da kuka yi wa waɗansu, da ita za a shari’anta ku. Mudun da kuka yi awo da shi, da shi za a yi muku.

title: Matta 7:3
content: 3 “Don me kake duban ɗan tsinken da yake idon ɗan’uwanka, alhali kuwa ga gungume a naka ido?

title: Matta 7:4
content: 4 Yaya za ka ce wa ɗan’uwanka, ‘Bari in cire maka ɗan tsinken nan daga idonka,’ alhali kuwa a kowane lokaci akwai gungume a naka ido?

title: Matta 7:5
content: 5 Kai munafuki, fara cire gungumen da yake idonka, a sa’an nan ne za ka iya gani sosai yadda za ka cire ɗan tsinken da yake a idon ɗan’uwanka.

title: Matta 7:6
content: 6 “Kada ku ba karnuka abin da yake mai tsarki; kada kuma ku jefa wa aladu lu’ulu’anku. In kuka yi haka za su tattake su, sa’an nan su juyo su jijji muku ciwo.

title: Matta 7:7
content: 7 “Ku roƙa za a ba ku; ku nema za ku samu; ku ƙwanƙwasa za a kuwa buɗe muku ƙofa.

title: Matta 7:8
content: 8 Gama duk wanda ya roƙa, akan ba shi; wanda ya nema kuwa, yakan samu, wanda kuma ya ƙwanƙwasa, za a buɗe masa ƙofa.

title: Matta 7:9
content: 9 “Wane ne a cikinku in ɗansa ya roƙe shi burodi, sai yă ba shi dutse?

title: Matta 7:10
content: 10 Ko kuwa in ya roƙe shi kifi, sai yă ba shi maciji?

title: Matta 7:11
content: 11 In ku da kuke mugaye kun san yadda za ku ba da kyautai masu kyau ga ’ya’yanku, balle Ubanku na sama, ba zai fi ku iya ba da abubuwa masu kyau, ga su waɗanda suka roƙe shi ba!

title: Matta 7:12
content: 12 Saboda haka, duk abin da kuke so mutane su yi muku, ku ma sai ku yi musu, domin wannan shi ne Doka da koyarwar Annabawa sun ƙunsa.

title: Matta 7:13
content: 13 “Ku shiga ta matsattsiyar ƙofa. Gama ƙofar zuwa hallaka faɗaɗɗiya ce mai sauƙin bi kuma, masu shiga ta cikinta kuwa suna da yawa.

title: Matta 7:14
content: 14 Amma ƙofar zuwa rai, ƙarama ce matsattsiya kuma, masu samunta kuwa kaɗan ne.

title: Matta 7:15
content: 15 “Ku yi hankali da annabawan ƙarya. Sukan zo muku da kamannin tumaki, amma daga ciki mugayen kyarketai ne.

title: Matta 7:16
content: 16 Ta wurin aikinsu za ku gane su. Mutane suna iya tsinkan inabi a jikin ƙaya, ko kuwa ɓaure a jikin sarƙaƙƙiya?

title: Matta 7:17
content: 17 Haka ma kowane itace mai kyau yakan ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau, kuma mummunan itace ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau.

title: Matta 7:18
content: 18 Itace mai kyau ba ya ba da munanan ’ya’ya, haka kuma mummunan itace ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau.

title: Matta 7:19
content: 19 Duk itacen da ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau sai a sare shi a jefa cikin wuta.

title: Matta 7:20
content: 20 Ta haka, ta wurin aikinsu za ku gane su.”

title: Matta 7:21
content: 21 “Ba duk mai ce mini, ‘Ubangiji, Ubangiji,’ ne zai shiga mulkin sama ba, sai dai wanda yake aikata nufin Ubana da yake sama.

title: Matta 7:22
content: 22 Da yawa za su ce mini a wannan rana, ‘Ubangiji, Ubangiji, ashe, ba mu yi annabci a cikin sunanka ba, ba kuma a cikin sunanka ne muka fitar da aljanu, muka yi abubuwan banmamaki da yawa ba?’

title: Matta 7:23
content: 23 Sa’an nan zan ce musu a fili, ‘Ban taɓa saninku ba. Ku rabu da ni, ku masu aikata mugunta!’

title: Matta 7:24
content: 24 “Saboda haka duk wanda yake jin kalmomin nan nawa yake kuma aikata su, yana kama da mutum mai hikima wanda ya gina gidansa a kan dutse.

title: Matta 7:25
content: 25 Ruwan sama ya sauko, rafuffuka suka cika, iska kuma ta hura ta bugi gidan; duk da haka bai fāɗi ba, gama yana da harsashinsa a kan dutse.

title: Matta 7:26
content: 26 Amma duk wanda yake jin kalmomin nan nawa bai kuwa aikata su ba, yana kama da wani wawa wanda ya gina gidansa a kan yashi.

title: Matta 7:27
content: 27 Ruwan sama ya sauko, rafuffuka suka cika, iska kuwa ta hura ta bugi gidan, sai ya fāɗi da mummunar ragargajewa kuwa.”

title: Matta 7:28
content: 28 Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama faɗin waɗannan abubuwa, sai taron mutanen suka yi mamakin koyarwarsa,

title: Matta 7:29
content: 29 domin ya koyar kamar wani wanda yake da iko, ba kamar malamansu na dokoki ba.

title: Matta 8:1
content: 1 Da ya sauko daga dutsen, sai taron mutane mai yawan gaske suka bi shi.

title: Matta 8:2
content: 2 Wani mutum mai kuturta ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa ya ce, “Ubangiji, in kana so, kana iya tsabtacce ni.”

title: Matta 8:3
content: 3 Yesu ya miƙa hannunsa ya taɓa mutumin. Ya ce, “Ina so, ka tsabtacce!” Nan da nan aka warkar da shi daga kuturtarsa.

title: Matta 8:4
content: 4 Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka lura kada ka gaya wa kowa. Sai dai ka tafi, ka nuna kanka ga firist ka kuma yi bayarwar da Musa ya umarta, a matsayin shaida gare su.”

title: Matta 8:5
content: 5 Da Yesu ya shiga Kafarnahum, sai wani jarumi ya zo wurinsa, yana neman taimako.

title: Matta 8:6
content: 6 Ya ce, “Ubangiji, bawana yana kwance a gida shanyayye, yana kuma shan azaba ƙwarai.”

title: Matta 8:7
content: 7 Yesu ya ce masa, “Zan je in warkar da shi.”

title: Matta 8:8
content: 8 Jarumin ya amsa, “Ubangiji, ban cancanci in sa ka zo gidana ba, ka dai yi magana kawai, bawana zai warke.

title: Matta 8:9
content: 9 Gama ni kaina mutum ne a ƙarƙashin iko, da kuma sojoji a ƙarƙashina. Nakan ce wa wannan, ‘Je ka,’ sai yă tafi; wancan kuma, ‘Zo nan,’ sai yă zo. Nakan ce wa bawana, ‘Yi wannan,’ sai kuwa yă yi.”

title: Matta 8:10
content: 10 Da Yesu ya ji wannan, sai ya yi mamaki ya kuma ce wa waɗanda suke binsa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ban taɓa samun wani a Isra’ila da bangaskiya mai girma haka ba.

title: Matta 8:11
content: 11 Ina kuma gaya muku da yawa za su zo daga gabas da kuma yamma, su ɗauki wuraren zamansu a biki tare da Ibrahim, Ishaku, da Yaƙub a cikin mulkin sama.

title: Matta 8:12
content: 12 Amma za a jefar da ’ya’yan mulki waje, zuwa cikin baƙin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.”

title: Matta 8:13
content: 13 Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa jarumin, “Je ka! Za a yi bisa ga bangaskiyarka.” A daidai wannan lokaci bawansa kuwa ya warke.

title: Matta 8:14
content: 14 Da Yesu ya zo cikin gidan Bitrus, sai ya ga surukar Bitrus tana kwance a gado tana da zazzaɓi.

title: Matta 8:15
content: 15 Ya taɓa hannunta sai zazzaɓin ya sake ta, ta kuwa tashi ta fara yin masa hidima.

title: Matta 8:16
content: 16 Da yamma ta yi, aka kawo masa masu aljanu da yawa, ya kuwa fitar da ruhohin ta wurin magana, ya kuma warkar da dukan marasa lafiya.

title: Matta 8:17
content: 17 Wannan ya faru ne domin a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Ishaya cewa, “Ya ɗebi rashin lafiyarmu, ya kuma ɗauki cututtukanmu.”

title: Matta 8:18
content: 18 Da Yesu ya ga taron mutane kewaye da shi, sai ya ba da umarni a ƙetare zuwa ɗayan hayin tafkin.

title: Matta 8:19
content: 19 Sai wani malamin dokoki ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “Malam, zan bi ka duk inda za ka.”

title: Matta 8:20
content: 20 Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yanyawa suna da ramummuka, tsuntsayen sararin sama suna da sheƙuna, amma Ɗan Mutum ba shi da wurin da zai sa kansa.”

title: Matta 8:21
content: 21 Sai wani almajiri ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, da farko bari in je in binne mahaifina.”

title: Matta 8:22
content: 22 Amma Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka bi ni, ka bar matattu su binne matattunsu.”

title: Matta 8:23
content: 23 Sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa, almajiransa kuwa suka bi shi.

title: Matta 8:24
content: 24 Ba zato ba tsammani, sai wani babban hadari ya taso a tafkin, har raƙuman ruwan suka sha kan jirgin. Amma Yesu yana barci.

title: Matta 8:25
content: 25 Almajiran suka je suka tashe shi, suna cewa, “Ubangiji, ka cece mu! Za mu nutse!”

title: Matta 8:26
content: 26 Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya, me ya sa kuke tsoro haka?” Sa’an nan ya tashi ya tsawata wa iskar da kuma raƙuman ruwan, sai wuri ya yi tsit gaba ɗaya.

title: Matta 8:27
content: 27 Mutanen suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Wane irin mutum ne wannan? Har iska da raƙuman ruwa suna masa biyayya!”

title: Matta 8:28
content: 28 Da ya isa ɗayan gefen a yankin Gadarenawa (ko kuwa Gerasenawa), sai ga mutum biyu masu aljanu suna fitowa daga kaburbura suka tarye shi. Su abin tsoro ne ƙwarai, har ba mai iya bin wannan hanya.

title: Matta 8:29
content: 29 Suka yi ihu suka ce, “Me ya haɗa ka da mu, Ɗan Allah?” Ka zo ne nan don ka ji mana kafin lokaci yă yi?

title: Matta 8:30
content: 30 Nesa kaɗan da su kuwa akwai babban garken aladu da yake kiwo.

title: Matta 8:31
content: 31 Aljanun suka roƙi Yesu suka ce, “In ka fitar da mu, tura mu cikin garken aladun nan.”

title: Matta 8:32
content: 32 Ya ce musu, “Ku tafi!” Sai suka fita suka shiga cikin aladun, dukan garken kuwa ya gangara a guje daga kan tudun zuwa cikin tafkin aladun kuma suka mutu a cikin ruwa.

title: Matta 8:33
content: 33 Masu kiwon aladun suka ruga, suka je cikin gari suka ba da labarin dukan wannan, haɗe da abin da ya faru da mutanen nan masu aljanu.

title: Matta 8:34
content: 34 Sai dukan garin suka fito don su taryi Yesu. Da suka kuwa gan shi, sai suka roƙe shi yă bar musu yanki.

title: Matta 9:1
content: 1 Yesu ya shiga jirgin ruwa, ya ƙetare ya zo garinsa.

title: Matta 9:2
content: 2 Waɗansu mutane suka kawo masa wani shanyayye, kwance a tabarma. Da Yesu ya ga bangaskiyarsu, sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Kada ka damu saurayi, an gafarta maka zunubanka.”

title: Matta 9:3
content: 3 Da jin wannan, waɗansu malaman dokoki suka ce wa juna, “Wannan mutum yana yin saɓo!”

title: Matta 9:4
content: 4 Sane da tunaninsu, Yesu ya ce, “Me ya sa kuke da mugun tunani a zuciyarku?

title: Matta 9:5
content: 5 Wanne ya fi sauƙi, a ce, ‘An gafarta maka zunubanka,’ ko kuwa a ce, ‘Tashi ka yi tafiya?’

title: Matta 9:6
content: 6 Amma don ku san cewa Ɗan Mutum yana da iko a duniya yă gafarta zunubai.” Sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Tashi, ɗauki tabarmarka ka tafi gida.”

title: Matta 9:7
content: 7 Mutumin kuwa ya tashi ya tafi gida.

title: Matta 9:8
content: 8 Da taron suka ga haka, sai suka cika da tsoro, suka yabi Allah wanda ya ba wa mutane irin ikon nan.

title: Matta 9:9
content: 9 Da Yesu ya yi gaba daga wurin, sai ya ga wani mutum mai suna Mattiyu zaune a inda ake karɓar haraji. Ya ce masa, “Bi ni.” Mattiyu kuwa ya tashi ya bi shi.

title: Matta 9:10
content: 10 Yayinda Yesu yake cin abinci a gidan Mattiyu, masu karɓar haraji da yawa da kuma masu zunubi suka zo suka kuwa ci tare da shi da kuma almajiransa.

title: Matta 9:11
content: 11 Sa’ad da Farisiyawa suka ga haka, sai suka tambayi almajiransa suka ce, “Don me malaminku yake ci tare da masu karɓar haraji, da masu zunubi?”

title: Matta 9:12
content: 12 Da jin wannan, Yesu ya ce, “Ai, ba masu lafiya ba ne su bukatar likita, sai dai marasa lafiya.

title: Matta 9:13
content: 13 Amma ku je ku koyi abin da wannan yake nufi, ‘Jinƙai nake bukata, ba hadaya ba.’ Gama ban zo domin in kira masu adalci ba, sai dai masu zunubi.”

title: Matta 9:14
content: 14 Sai almajiran Yohanna suka zo suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Me ya sa mu da Farisiyawa muke azumi, amma almajiranka ba sa yi?”

title: Matta 9:15
content: 15 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yaya baƙin ango za su yi makoki yayinda yake tare da su? Lokaci yana zuwa da za a ɗauke ango daga gare su, sa’an nan za su yi azumi.

title: Matta 9:16
content: 16 “Ba mai yin faci da sabon ƙyalle a kan tsohuwar riga, gama facin zai kece rigar yă sa kecewar ma ta fi ta dā muni.

title: Matta 9:17
content: 17 Mutane kuma ba sa zuba sabon ruwan inabi a cikin tsofaffin salkuna. In suka yi haka, salkunan za su farfashe, ruwan inabin kuwa yă zube salkunan kuma su lalace. A’a, ai, sukan zuba sabon ruwan inabi ne a cikin sababbin salkuna, don a kiyaye dukan biyun.”

title: Matta 9:18
content: 18 Yayinda yake faɗin wannan, sai wani mai mulki ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa ya ce, “Yanzu-yanzu diyata ta rasu. Amma ka zo ka ɗibiya hannunka a kanta, za tă kuwa rayu.”

title: Matta 9:19
content: 19 Yesu ya tashi ya tafi tare da shi, haka ma almajiransa.

title: Matta 9:20
content: 20 A daidai wannan lokaci sai ga wata mace wadda ta yi shekaru goma sha biyu tana zub da jini ta raɓo ta bayansa ta taɓa gefen rigarsa.

title: Matta 9:21
content: 21 Ta ce a ranta, “Ko da rigarsa ce kawai na taɓo, zan warke.”

title: Matta 9:22
content: 22 Yesu ya juya ya gan ta. Sai ya ce, “Kada ki damu diyata, bangaskiyarki ta warkar da ke.” Nan take macen ta warke.

title: Matta 9:23
content: 23 Da Yesu ya shiga gidan mai mulkin ya ga masu busan sarewa da taro mai hayaniya,

title: Matta 9:24
content: 24 sai ya ce, “Ku ba da wuri. Ai, yarinyar ba tă mutu ba, tana barci ne.” Amma suka yi masa dariya.

title: Matta 9:25
content: 25 Bayan an fitar da taron waje, sai ya shiga ciki ya kama yarinyar a hannu, ta kuwa tashi.

title: Matta 9:26
content: 26 Labarin wannan kuwa ya bazu ko’ina a yankin.

title: Matta 9:27
content: 27 Da Yesu ya fita daga can, sai waɗansu makafi biyu suka bi shi, suna kira, suna cewa, “Ka yi mana jinƙai, Ɗan Dawuda!”

title: Matta 9:28
content: 28 Da ya shiga cikin gida, sai makafin nan suka zo wurinsa, ya kuma tambaye su, “Kun gaskata cewa ina iya yin wannan?” Suka amsa suka ce, “I, Ubangiji.”

title: Matta 9:29
content: 29 Sa’an nan ya taɓa idanunsu ya ce, “Bisa ga bangaskiyarku a yi muku haka”;

title: Matta 9:30
content: 30 sai idanunsu suka buɗe. Yesu ya gargaɗe su sosai ya ce, “Ku lura kada wani yă san wani abu game da wannan.”

title: Matta 9:31
content: 31 Amma suka fita suka yi ta baza labari game da shi ko’ina a wannan yankin.

title: Matta 9:32
content: 32 Yayinda suke fitowa, sai aka kawo wa Yesu wani mutum mai aljani, da ba ya iya magana.

title: Matta 9:33
content: 33 Sa’ad da aka fitar da aljanin kuwa, sai beben ya yi magana. Taron suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Ba a taɓa ganin irin wannan abu a Isra’ila ba.”

title: Matta 9:34
content: 34 Amma Farisiyawa suka ce, “Ai, da ikon sarkin aljanu yake fitar da aljanu.”

title: Matta 9:35
content: 35 Yesu ya zazzaga dukan garuruwa da ƙauyuka, yana koyarwa a majami’unsu, yana wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin yana kuma warkar da kowace irin cuta da rashin lafiya.

title: Matta 9:36
content: 36 Da ya ga taron mutane, sai ya ji tausayinsu, domin an wulaƙanta su ba su kuma da mai taimako, kamar tumaki marasa makiyayi.

title: Matta 9:37
content: 37 Sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Girbi yana da yawa, amma ma’aikata kaɗan ne.

title: Matta 9:38
content: 38 Saboda haka ku roƙi Ubangijin girbi, yă aiko da ma’aikata cikin gonarsa na girbi.”

title: Matta 10:1
content: 1 Sai ya kira almajiransa goma sha biyu wurinsa ya kuma ba su iko su fitar aljanu, su kuma warkar da kowace irin cuta da rashin lafiya.

title: Matta 10:2
content: 2 Ga sunayen manzannin nan goma sha biyu, da fari, Siman (wanda ake kira Bitrus) da ɗan’uwansa Andarawus; Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi da ɗan’uwansa Yohanna;

title: Matta 10:3
content: 3 Filibus da Bartolomeyu; Toma da Mattiyu mai karɓar haraji; Yaƙub ɗan Alfayus da Taddayus;

title: Matta 10:4
content: 4 Siman Zilot da kuma Yahuda Iskariyot wanda ya bashe Yesu.

title: Matta 10:5
content: 5 Waɗannan sha biyun ne Yesu ya aika da umarni cewa, “Kada ku je cikin Al’ummai, ko kuwa ku shiga wani garin Samariyawa.

title: Matta 10:6
content: 6 A maimakon haka ku je wajen ɓatattun tumakin Isra’ila.

title: Matta 10:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da kuke tafiya, ku yi wa’azi, kuna cewa, ‘Mulkin sama ya kusato.’

title: Matta 10:8
content: 8 Ku warkar da marasa lafiya, ku tā da matattu, ku tsabtacce kutare, ku kuma fitar da aljanu. A kyauta kuka samu, ku kuma bayar a kyauta.

title: Matta 10:9
content: 9 “Kada ku riƙe wata zinariya ko azurfa ko jan ƙarfe a aljihunanku,

title: Matta 10:10
content: 10 kada ku ɗauki jaka don tafiya, ko ƙarin riga, ko takalma ko sanda; domin ma’aikaci ya cancanci hakkinsa.

title: Matta 10:11
content: 11 Kowane gari ko ƙauyen da kuka shiga, ku nemi mai mutunci a wurin, ku kuma zauna a gidansa har sai kun tashi.

title: Matta 10:12
content: 12 Da shigarku gidan, ku yi gaisuwa.

title: Matta 10:13
content: 13 In gidan na kirki ne, bari salamarku ta zauna a kansa; in kuwa ba mai kirki ba, salamarku ta komo muku.

title: Matta 10:14
content: 14 Duk wanda ya ƙi marabtarku ko ya ƙi sauraron kalmominku, sai ku karkaɗe ƙurar ƙafafunku sa’ad da kuka fita gidan ko garin.

title: Matta 10:15
content: 15 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, za a fi jin tausayin Sodom da Gomorra a ranar shari’a fiye da wannan gari.

title: Matta 10:16
content: 16 “Ina aikan ku kamar tumaki a cikin kyarketai. Saboda haka ku zama masu wayo kamar macizai, kuma marasa ɓarna kamar kurciyoyi.

title: Matta 10:17
content: 17 Ku yi hankali da mutane; za su miƙa ku ga majalisa su kuma yi muku bulala a majami’unsu.

title: Matta 10:18
content: 18 Saboda ni, za a ja ku zuwa gaban gwamnoni da gaban sarakuna domin ku ba da shaida a gabansu, da kuma ga Al’ummai.

title: Matta 10:19
content: 19 Amma sa’ad da suka kama ku, kada ku damu game da abin da za ku faɗa ko kuwa yadda za ku faɗe shi. A lokacin za a ba ku abin da za ku faɗa,

title: Matta 10:20
content: 20 gama ba ku ba ne kuke magana, amma Ruhun Ubanku ne yake magana ta wurinku.

title: Matta 10:21
content: 21 “Ɗan’uwa zai ci amanar ɗan’uwansa, a kuma kashe shi, Uba ma zai yi haka da ɗansa; ’ya’ya za su tayar wa iyayensu, su kuma sa a kashe su.

title: Matta 10:22
content: 22 Dukan mutane za su ƙi ku saboda ni, amma wanda ya jure har ƙarshe zai sami ceto.

title: Matta 10:23
content: 23 Sa’ad da aka tsananta muku a wannan wuri, ku gudu zuwa wancan. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, kafin ku gama zazzaga dukan biranen Isra’ila, Ɗan Mutum zai zo.

title: Matta 10:24
content: 24 “Ɗalibi ba ya fin malaminsa, haka ma, bawa ba ya fin maigidansa.

title: Matta 10:25
content: 25 Ya isa wa ɗalibi yă zama kamar malaminsa, haka ma bawa kamar maigidansa. In har an kira wanda yake kan gida Be’elzebub, me za su ce game da mutanen gidansa?

title: Matta 10:26
content: 26 “Saboda haka kada ku ji tsoronsu. Ba abin da yake a rufe da ba za a tone ba, ko kuwa a ɓoye da ba za a bayyana ba.

title: Matta 10:27
content: 27 Abin da na faɗa muku a asirce, ku faɗe shi a sarari; abin da aka faɗa muku a kunne, ku yi shelarsa daga kan rufin ɗaki.

title: Matta 10:28
content: 28 Kada ku ji tsoron masu kashe jiki amma ba sa iya kashe rai. A maimakon haka, ku ji tsoron Wannan wanda yake da iko yă hallaka rai duk da jiki a jahannama ta wuta.

title: Matta 10:29
content: 29 Ba akan sayar da kanari biyu kobo ɗaya ba? Duk da haka ba ɗayansu da zai fāɗi ƙasa ba da yardar Ubanku.

title: Matta 10:30
content: 30 Kai, ko gashin kanku ma duk an ƙidaya su.

title: Matta 10:31
content: 31 Saboda haka kada ku ji tsoro; kun fi kanari masu yawa, daraja nesa.

title: Matta 10:32
content: 32 “Duk wanda ya bayyana yarda a gare ni a gaban mutane, ni ma zan bayyana yarda a gare shi a gaban Ubana da yake cikin sama.

title: Matta 10:33
content: 33 Amma duk wanda ya yi mūsun sani na a gaban mutane, ni ma zan yi mūsun saninsa a gaban Ubana da yake cikin sama.

title: Matta 10:34
content: 34 “Kada fa ku ɗauka na zo ne don in kawo salama a duniya. A’a, ban zo don in kawo salama ba, sai dai takobi.

title: Matta 10:35
content: 35 Gama na zo ne in sa, “ ‘gāba tsakanin mutum da mahaifinsa, ’ya da mahaifiyarta, matar ɗa da surukarta,

title: Matta 10:36
content: 36 abokan gāban mutum, za su zama mutanen gidansa ne.’

title: Matta 10:37
content: 37 “Duk wanda ya fi ƙaunar mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa fiye da ni, bai dace yă zama nawa ba; duk kuwa wanda yake ƙaunar ɗansa ko diyarsa fiye da ni, bai dace yă zama nawa ba;

title: Matta 10:38
content: 38 duk wanda kuma bai ɗauki gicciyensa ya bi ni ba, bai dace yă zama nawa ba.

title: Matta 10:39
content: 39 Duk mai son adana ransa zai rasa shi, duk wanda kuwa ya rasa ransa saboda ni zai same shi.

title: Matta 10:40
content: 40 “Wanda ya karɓe ku, ya karɓe ni ne, wanda kuma ya karɓe ni, ya karɓi wanda ya aiko ni ne.

title: Matta 10:41
content: 41 Duk wanda ya karɓi annabi don shi annabi ne, zai sami ladar annabi, duk kuwa wanda ya karɓi mutum mai adalci don shi mai adalci ne, zai sami ladar mai adalci.

title: Matta 10:42
content: 42 In kuma wani ya ba wa ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan ko da kwaf ruwan sanyi ne kan shi almajirina ne, gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba shakka ba zai rasa ladarsa ba.”

title: Matta 11:1
content: 1 Bayan Yesu ya gama yi wa almajiransa sha biyun nan umarni, sai ya yi gaba daga can don yă koyar yă kuma yi wa’azi a garuruwan Galili.

title: Matta 11:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya ji a kurkuku abin da Kiristi yake yi, sai ya aiki almajiransa

title: Matta 11:3
content: 3 su tambaye shi, “Kai ne wanda zai zo, ko kuwa mu sa ido ga wani?”

title: Matta 11:4
content: 4 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku koma ku gaya wa Yohanna abin da kuka ji, kuka kuma gani.

title: Matta 11:5
content: 5 Makafi suna gani, guragu suna tafiya, ana warkar da waɗanda suke da kuturta, kurame suna ji, ana tā da matattu, ana kuma yi wa matalauta wa’azin labari mai daɗi.

title: Matta 11:6
content: 6 Mai albarka ne mutumin da bai yi tuntuɓe ba saboda ni.”

title: Matta 11:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da almajiran Yohanna suke barin wurin, sai Yesu ya fara yi wa taron magana game da Yohanna. “Me kuka je kallo a hamada? Ciyawar da iska take kaɗawa ne?

title: Matta 11:8
content: 8 In ba haka ba, to, me kuka je kallo? Mutum mai sanye da riguna masu kyau ne? A’a, masu sa riguna masu kyau, ai, a fadan sarakuna suke.

title: Matta 11:9
content: 9 To, me kuka je kallo ne? Annabi? I, ina gaya muku, ya ma fi annabi.

title: Matta 11:10
content: 10 Wannan shi ne wanda aka rubuta game da shi cewa, “ ‘Zan aiki ɗan saƙona yă sha gabanka, wanda zai shirya hanyarka a gabanka.’

title: Matta 11:11
content: 11 Gaskiya nake gaya muku. A cikin dukan waɗanda mata suka haifa, ba wani da ya taso da ya fi Yohanna Mai Baftisma girma; duk da haka mafi ƙanƙanta a mulkin sama ya fi shi girma.

title: Matta 11:12
content: 12 Tun daga kwanakin Yohanna Mai Baftisma har yă zuwa yanzu, mulkin sama yana sha da ƙyar, fitanannu kuma sun kama mulkin sama sun riƙe gam.

title: Matta 11:13
content: 13 Gama dukan Annabawa da kuma Doka sun yi ta annabci har yă zuwa kan Yohanna.

title: Matta 11:14
content: 14 In kuna niyya ku yarda da wannan, to, shi ne Iliya da dā ma zai zo.

title: Matta 11:15
content: 15 Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.

title: Matta 11:16
content: 16 “Da me zan kwatanta wannan zamani? Suna kama da yara da suke zaune a kasuwa, suna kiran juna, suna cewa,

title: Matta 11:17
content: 17 “ ‘Mun yi muku busa, ba ku kuwa yi rawa ba, mun rera waƙar makoki, ba ku kuwa yi makoki ba.’

title: Matta 11:18
content: 18 Gama Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo ba ya ciye-ciye, ba ya shaye-shaye, sai suka ce, ‘Ai, yana da aljani.’

title: Matta 11:19
content: 19 Ɗan Mutum ya zo yana ciye-ciye, yana shaye-shaye, sai suka ce, ‘Ga mai haɗama da kuma mashayi, abokin masu karɓar haraji da masu zunubi.’ Amma akan tabbatar da hikima ta wurin ayyukanta.”

title: Matta 11:20
content: 20 Sai Yesu ya fara yin tir da biranen da aka yi yawancin ayyukansa na banmamaki, don ba su tuba ba.

title: Matta 11:21
content: 21 “Kaitonki, Korazin! Kaitonki, Betsaida! Da a ce ayyukan banmamakin da aka yi a cikinki ne aka yi a Taya da Sidon, da tuni sun tuba sanye da rigar makoki da toka.

title: Matta 11:22
content: 22 Amma ina gaya muku, za a fi jin tausayin Taya da Sidon a ranar shari’a, fiye da ku.

title: Matta 11:23
content: 23 Ke kuma Kafarnahum, za a ɗaga ki sama ne? A’a, za ki gangara zuwa zurfafa ne. Da a ce ayyukan banmamakin da aka yi a cikinki ne a aka yi a Sodom, da tana nan har yă zuwa yau.

title: Matta 11:24
content: 24 Amma ina gaya miki, za a fi jin tausayin Sodom fiye da ke a ranar shari’a.”

title: Matta 11:25
content: 25 A wannan lokaci sai Yesu ya ce, “Ina yabonka, Uba, Ubangijin sama da ƙasa, gama ka ɓoye waɗannan abubuwa ga masu hikima da masu ilimi, ka kuma bayyana su ga ƙananan yara.

title: Matta 11:26
content: 26 I, Uba, gama wannan shi ne abin da ka ji daɗin yi.

title: Matta 11:27
content: 27 “Dukan kome Ubana ya danƙa mini. Ba wanda ya san Ɗan sai dai Uban, ba kuma wanda ya san Uban, sai dai Ɗan da kuma waɗanda Ɗan ya so yă bayyana musu shi.

title: Matta 11:28
content: 28 “Ku zo gare ni, dukanku da kuka gaji kuke kuma fama da kaya, zan kuwa ba ku hutu.

title: Matta 11:29
content: 29 Ku ɗauki karkiyata a kanku, ku kuma yi koyi da ni, gama ni mai tawali’u ne marar girman kai, za ku kuwa sami hutu don rayukanku.

title: Matta 11:30
content: 30 Gama karkiyata mai sauƙi ce, kayana kuma marasa nauyi ne.”

title: Matta 12:1
content: 1 A lokacin nan Yesu ya bi ta gonakin hatsi a ranar Asabbaci. Almajiransa kuwa suna jin yunwa, sai suka fara kakkarya kan hatsi suna ci.

title: Matta 12:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da Farisiyawa suka ga wannan, sai suka ce masa, “Duba! Almajiranka suna yin abin da doka ta hana a yi a ranar Asabbaci.”

title: Matta 12:3
content: 3 Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ku karanta abin da Dawuda ya yi ba ne sa’ad da shi da abokan tafiyarsa suka ji yunwa?

title: Matta 12:4
content: 4 Ya shiga gidan Allah, da shi da abokan tafiyarsa suka ci keɓaɓɓen burodin, wanda doka ta hana su yi, sai firistoci kaɗai.

title: Matta 12:5
content: 5 Ko kuwa ba ku karanta a Doka cewa a ranar Asabbaci firistoci sukan karya dokar Asabbaci duk da haka ba da yin wani laifi ba?

title: Matta 12:6
content: 6 Ina faɗa muku cewa wani wanda ya fi haikali yana a nan.

title: Matta 12:7
content: 7 Da a ce kun san abin da waɗannan kalmomi suke nufi, ‘Jinƙai nake bukata, ba hadaya ba,’ da ba ku zargi marar laifi ba.

title: Matta 12:8
content: 8 Gama Ɗan Mutum shi ne Ubangijin Asabbaci.”

title: Matta 12:9
content: 9 Da ya ci gaba daga wurin, sai ya shiga majami’arsu,

title: Matta 12:10
content: 10 a nan kuwa akwai wani mutum mai shanyayyen hannu. Don neman dalili su zargi Yesu, sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ya dace a warkar a ranar Asabbaci?”

title: Matta 12:11
content: 11 Ya ce musu, “In waninku yana da tunkiya, ta kuma fāɗa a rami ran Asabbaci, ba zai cire ta daga ramin ba?

title: Matta 12:12
content: 12 Sau nawa mutum ya fi tunkiya daraja! Saboda haka ya dace a aikata alheri ran Asabbaci.”

title: Matta 12:13
content: 13 Sa’an nan ya ce wa mutumin, “Miƙa hannunka.” Sai ya miƙa, hannunsa kuwa ya koma lafiyayye, kamar dai ɗayan.

title: Matta 12:14
content: 14 Amma Farisiyawa suka fita suka ƙulla shawara yadda za su kashe Yesu.

title: Matta 12:15
content: 15 Da ya gane wannan, sai Yesu ya janye daga wurin. Da yawa suka bi shi, ya kuwa warkar da dukan masu ciwonsu,

title: Matta 12:16
content: 16 yana jan musu kunne kada su faɗa wa kowa akan ko shi wane ne.

title: Matta 12:17
content: 17 Wannan kuwa domin a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Ishaya ne cewa,

title: Matta 12:18
content: 18 “Ga bawana da na zaɓa, ƙaunataccena, wanda nake farin ciki da shi; zan sa Ruhuna a kansa, zai kuma yi shelar adalci ga al’ummai.

title: Matta 12:19
content: 19 Ba zai yi faɗa ko yă ɗaga murya ba, ba kuwa wanda zai ji muryarsa a kan tituna.

title: Matta 12:20
content: 20 Kyauron da ya tanƙwasa ba zai karye shi ba. Fitilar da ta yi kusan mutuwa ba zai kashe ta ba, sai ya jagoranci adalci zuwa ga nasara.

title: Matta 12:21
content: 21 Cikin sunansa al’ummai za su dogara.”

title: Matta 12:22
content: 22 Sai aka kawo masa wani bebe kuma makaho mai aljani, Yesu kuwa ya warkar da shi, har ya iya magana ya kuma sami ganin gari.

title: Matta 12:23
content: 23 Dukan mutane suka yi mamaki, suka ce, “Wannan Ɗan Dawuda ne kuwa?”

title: Matta 12:24
content: 24 Amma da Farisiyawa suka ji haka, sai suka ce, “Ahab, da Be’elzebub sarkin aljanu ne kaɗai, wannan mutum yake fitar da aljanu.”

title: Matta 12:25
content: 25 Yesu kuwa ya san tunaninsu sai ya ce musu, “Duk mulkin da yake gāba da kansa zai lalace, kuma duk birni ko gidan da yake rabe gāba da kansa ba zai ɗore ba.

title: Matta 12:26
content: 26 In Shaiɗan yana fitar da Shaiɗan, ai, ya rabu yana gāba da kansa ke nan. Yaya kuwa mulkinsa zai ɗore?

title: Matta 12:27
content: 27 In kuwa ta wurin Be’elzebub nake fitar da aljanu, to, ta wa mutanenku suke fitar da su? Saboda haka, su ne za su zama alƙalanku.

title: Matta 12:28
content: 28 Amma in ina fitar da aljanu ta wurin Ruhun Allah ne, to, fa, mulkin Allah ya zo muku ke nan.

title: Matta 12:29
content: 29 “Ko kuwa, yaya wani zai iya shiga gidan mai ƙarfi yă ƙwace masa kaya ba tare da ya fara daure mai ƙarfin nan tukuna ba? Sa’an nan zai iya washe gidansa.

title: Matta 12:30
content: 30 “Wanda ba ya tare da ni, yana gāba da ni ne, kuma wanda ba ya taya ni tarawa, watsarwa yake yi.

title: Matta 12:31
content: 31 Saboda haka ina gaya muku, za a gafarta wa mutane kowane zunubi da kuma saɓo, amma saɓo game da Ruhu, ba za a gafarta ba.

title: Matta 12:32
content: 32 Duk wanda ya zargi Ɗan Mutum, za a gafarta masa, amma duk wanda ya zargi Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ba za a gafarta masa ba, ko a wannan zamani ko a zamani mai zuwa.

title: Matta 12:33
content: 33 “Itace mai kyau, yakan ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau. Itace marar kyau kuma, yakan ba da ’ya’ya marasa kyau. Itace dai, da irin ’ya’yansa ne ake gane shi.

title: Matta 12:34
content: 34 Ku macizai, ta yaya ku da kuke mugaye za ku iya magana kirki? Gama daga baki, mutum yakan faɗi abin da yake cikin zuciya.

title: Matta 12:35
content: 35 Mutumin kirki yakan fito da abubuwa masu kyau daga ajiyar da aka a yi cikinsa, mugun mutum kuwa yakan fito da mugayen abubuwa daga cikin muguntar da aka yi ajiya a cikinsa.

title: Matta 12:36
content: 36 Amma ina gaya muku cewa mutane za su ba da lissafi a ranar shari’a a kan kowace kalmar banza da suka faɗa.

title: Matta 12:37
content: 37 Gama ta wurin kalmominka za a kuɓutar da kai, kuma ta wurin kalmominka za a hukunta ka.”

title: Matta 12:38
content: 38 Sa’an nan waɗansu Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka ce masa, “Malam, muna so mu ga wata alama mai banmamaki daga gare ka.”

title: Matta 12:39
content: 39 Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Mugaye da masu zinan zamanin nan suna neman wata alama mai banmamaki! Amma babu wadda za a nuna musu, sai dai alama ta annabi Yunana.

title: Matta 12:40
content: 40 Gama kamar yadda Yunana ya yi yini uku da kuma dare uku a cikin wani babban kifi, haka Ɗan Mutum zai yi yini uku da kuma dare uku a cikin ƙasa.

title: Matta 12:41
content: 41 Mutanen Ninebe za su tashi a ranar shari’a tare da wannan zamani, su kuwa hukunta shi; don sun tuba saboda wa’azin Yunana, yanzu kuwa ga wanda ya fi Yunana girma a nan.

title: Matta 12:42
content: 42 Sarauniyar Sheba za tă tashi a ranar shari’a tare da wannan zamani, tă kuwa hukunta shi; don ta zo daga ƙarshen duniya, ta saurari hikimar Solomon, yanzu kuwa ga wanda ya fi Solomon girma a nan.

title: Matta 12:43
content: 43 “Sa’ad da mugun ruhu ya fita daga mutum, yakan bi wuraren da ba ruwa yana neman hutu, ba ya kuwa samu.

title: Matta 12:44
content: 44 Sa’an nan yakan ce, ‘Zan koma gidan da na bari.’ Sa’ad da ya iso, ya tarar da gidan ba kowa a ciki, shararre, kuma a kintse.

title: Matta 12:45
content: 45 Sai yă je yă ɗebo waɗansu ruhohi bakwai da suka fi shi mugunta, su kuwa zo su shiga su zauna a can. Ƙarshen mutumin nan fa zai fi farkonsa muni. Haka zai zama ga wannan mugun zamani.”

title: Matta 12:46
content: 46 Yayinda Yesu yake cikin magana da taron, sai ga mahaifiyarsa da ’yan’uwansa tsaye a waje, suna so su yi magana da shi.

title: Matta 12:47
content: 47 Wani ya ce masa, “Mahaifiyarka da ’yan’uwanka suna tsaye a waje, suna so su yi magana da kai.”

title: Matta 12:48
content: 48 Ya amsa masa ya ce, “Wace ce mahaifiyata, su wane ne kuma ’yan’uwana?”

title: Matta 12:49
content: 49 Sai ya miƙa hannu wajen almajiransa ya ce, “Ga mahaifiyata da kuma ’yan’uwana.

title: Matta 12:50
content: 50 Ai, duk wanda yake aikata nufin Ubana wanda yake cikin sama, shi ne ɗan’uwana da ’yar’uwata da kuma mahaifiyata.”

title: Matta 13:1
content: 1 A ranan nan sai Yesu ya fita daga gida ya je ya zauna a bakin tafkin.

title: Matta 13:2
content: 2 Taron mutane mai yawan gaske suka taru kewaye da shi har ya kai sai da ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya zauna, yayinda dukan mutane suka tsaya a gaci.

title: Matta 13:3
content: 3 Sa’an nan ya faɗa musu abubuwa da yawa cikin misalai, yana cewa, “Wani manomi ya fita don yă shuka irinsa.

title: Matta 13:4
content: 4 Da yana yafa irin, waɗansu suka fāffāɗi a kan hanya, tsuntsaye kuwa suka zo suka cinye su.

title: Matta 13:5
content: 5 Waɗansu suka fāɗi a wurare mai duwatsu, inda babu ƙasa sosai, nan da nan kuwa suka tsira, da yake ƙasar ba zurfi.

title: Matta 13:6
content: 6 Sai dai da rana ta ɗaga, sai tsire-tsiren suka ƙone, suka kuma yanƙwane domin ba su da saiwa sosai.

title: Matta 13:7
content: 7 Waɗansu irin suka fāɗi a cikin ƙaya, ƙayan kuwa ta yi girma ta shaƙe su.

title: Matta 13:8
content: 8 Har yanzu, waɗansu irin suka fāffāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau, inda suka ba da amfani riɓi ɗari, sittin ko kuma talatin na abin da aka shuka.

title: Matta 13:9
content: 9 Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”

title: Matta 13:10
content: 10 Almajiran suka zo wurinsa suka tambaye shi, “Me ya sa kake wa mutane magana da misalai?”

title: Matta 13:11
content: 11 Ya amsa ya ce, “Sanin asirin mulkin sama kam, ku aka ba wa, amma su ba a ba su ba.

title: Matta 13:12
content: 12 Duk wanda yake da shi, za a ƙara masa, zai kuwa samu a yalwace. Duk wanda kuma ba shi da shi, ko ɗan abin da yake da shi ma, za a karɓe.

title: Matta 13:13
content: 13 Abin da ya sa nake musu magana da misalai ke nan. “Ko da yake suna kallo, ba sa gani; ko da yake suna saurara, ba sa ji ko su gane.

title: Matta 13:14
content: 14 A kansu ne aka cika annabcin Ishaya cewa, “ ‘Za ku yi ta ji amma ba za ku taɓa ganewa ba; za ku yi ta kallo amma ba za ku taɓa gani ba.

title: Matta 13:15
content: 15 Gama zuciyar mutanen nan ta taurare; da ƙyar suke ji da kunnuwansu, sun kuma rufe idanunsu. Da ba haka ba, mai yiwuwa su gani da idanunsu, su kuma ji da kunnuwansu, su gane a zuciyarsu, su kuwa juya, in kuma warkar da su.’

title: Matta 13:16
content: 16 Amma idanunku masu albarka ne domin suna gani, haka ma kunnuwanku domin suna ji.

title: Matta 13:17
content: 17 Gama gaskiya nake gaya muku, annabawa da mutane masu adalci da yawa sun yi marmarin ganin abin da kuke gani amma ba su gani ba, su kuma ji abin da kuke ji amma ba su ji ba.

title: Matta 13:18
content: 18 “To, ku saurari ma’anar misali na mai shukan nan.

title: Matta 13:19
content: 19 Duk sa’ad da wani ya ji saƙo game da mulkin bai kuwa fahimce shi ba, mugun nan yakan zo yă ƙwace abin da aka shuka a zuciyarsa. Wannan shi ne irin da ya fāɗi a kan hanya.

title: Matta 13:20
content: 20 Wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi a wuraren duwatsu kuwa, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar, nan da nan kuwa yă karɓe ta da murna.

title: Matta 13:21
content: 21 Sai dai da yake ba shi da saiwa, yakan ɗan jima kaɗan kawai. Da wata wahala ko tsanani ya auko masa saboda maganar, nan da nan sai yă ja da baya.

title: Matta 13:22
content: 22 Wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi cikin ƙaya kuwa, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar, sai dai damuwoyin rayuwan nan da jarrabar arzikin duniya sukan shaƙe shi, yă sa maganar ta kāsa amfani.

title: Matta 13:23
content: 23 Amma wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar yă kuwa fahimce ta. Yakan ba da amfani wani riɓi ɗari, sittin, ko talatin na abin da aka shuka.”

title: Matta 13:24
content: 24 Yesu ya ba su wani misali. “Mulkin sama yana kama da wani da ya shuka iri mai kyau a cikin gonarsa.

title: Matta 13:25
content: 25 Amma yayinda kowa yake barci, abokin gābansa ya zo ya yafa ciyayi a cikin alkamar, ya tafi abinsa.

title: Matta 13:26
content: 26 Sa’ad da alkamar ta tashi ta yi kawuna, sai ciyayin ma suka bayyana.

title: Matta 13:27
content: 27 “Bayin mai gonar suka zo wurinsa suka ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, ashe, ba iri mai kyau ka shuka a gonarka ba? To, ina ciyayin nan suka fito?’

title: Matta 13:28
content: 28 “Sai ya ce, ‘Abokin gāba ne ya yi wannan.’ “Bayin suka tambaye shi suka ce, ‘Kana so mu je mu tuttumɓuke su?’

title: Matta 13:29
content: 29 “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘A’a, don kada garin tuttumɓuke ciyayi, ku cire har da alkamar.

title: Matta 13:30
content: 30 Ku ƙyale su su yi girma tare sai lokacin girbi. A lokacin zan gaya wa masu girbi, da fari ku tara ciyayin ku kuma daure su dami-dami don a ƙone; sa’an nan ku tara alkamar ku kuma kawo su cikin rumbuna.’ ”

title: Matta 13:31
content: 31 Ya ba su wani misali ya ce, “Mulkin sama yana kama da ƙwayar mustad, wadda mutum ya ɗauka ya shuka a gonarsa.

title: Matta 13:32
content: 32 Ko da yake ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta cikin ƙwayoyinku, duk da haka sa’ad da ta yi girma, takan zama mafi girma cikin tsire-tsiren lambu ta kuma zama itace, har tsuntsayen sararin sama su zo su yi sheƙa a rassansa.”

title: Matta 13:33
content: 33 Har yanzu ya ba su wani misali ya ce, “Mulkin sama yana kama da yisti wanda mace ta ɗauka ta kwaɓa garin alkama mai yawa, har sai da yistin ya gauraye yistin duka.”

title: Matta 13:34
content: 34 Yesu ya faɗa wa taron dukan waɗannan abubuwa cikin misalai; bai faɗa musu kome ba, sai tare da yin amfani da misalai.

title: Matta 13:35
content: 35 Ta haka aka cika abin da aka faɗa ta wurin annabi cewa, “Zan buɗe bakina da misalai, zan faɗi abubuwan da suke ɓoye tun halittar duniya.”

title: Matta 13:36
content: 36 Sa’an nan ya bar taron ya shiga gida. Almajiransa kuwa suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Bayyana mana misalin ciyayin nan a gona.”

title: Matta 13:37
content: 37 Ya amsa ya ce, “Mai yafa irin mai kyan nan, shi ne Ɗan Mutum.

title: Matta 13:38
content: 38 Gonar kuwa ita ce duniya, irin nan mai kyau kuwa suna a matsayin ’ya’yan mulkin. Ciyayin nan kuma su ne ’ya’yan mugun nan,

title: Matta 13:39
content: 39 abokin gāban da yake shuka su kuwa, Iblis ne. Lokacin girbi kuma shi ne ƙarshen zamani, masu girbin kuwa su ne mala’iku.

title: Matta 13:40
content: 40 “Kamar yadda aka tattara ciyayin aka kuma ƙone a wuta, haka zai zama a ƙarshen zamani.

title: Matta 13:41
content: 41 Ɗan Mutum zai aiki mala’ikunsa, su kuwa cire daga mulkinsa kome da yake jawo zunubi da kuma duk masu aikata mugunta.

title: Matta 13:42
content: 42 Za su jefa su cikin wuta mai zafi, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.

title: Matta 13:43
content: 43 Sa’an nan masu adalci za su haskaka kamar rana a mulkin Ubansu. Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”

title: Matta 13:44
content: 44 “Mulkin sama yana kama da dukiyar da aka ɓoye a gona. Da wani ya same ta, sai yă sāke ɓoye ta, sa’an nan cikin farin cikinsa yă je yă sayar da duk abin da yake da shi yă sayi gonar.

title: Matta 13:45
content: 45 “Har wa yau dai, mulkin sama yana kama da ɗan kasuwa mai neman lu’ulu’ai masu kyau.

title: Matta 13:46
content: 46 Da ya sami dutse guda mai daraja sosai, sai ya tafi ya sayar da dukan abin da yake da shi ya saye shi.

title: Matta 13:47
content: 47 “Har yanzu, mulkin sama yana kama da abin kamun kifin da aka jefa cikin tafki yă kamo kifi iri-iri.

title: Matta 13:48
content: 48 Da abin kamun kifi ya cika, masuntan suka jawo shi gaci. Sai suka zauna suka tattara kifi masu kyau a kwanduna, amma suka zubar da marasa kyau.

title: Matta 13:49
content: 49 Haka zai kasance a ƙarshen zamani. Mala’iku za su zo su ware masu mugunta daga masu adalci

title: Matta 13:50
content: 50 su kuma jefa su cikin wuta mai zafi, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.”

title: Matta 13:51
content: 51 Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Kun gane dukan waɗannan abubuwa?” Suka amsa, “I.”

title: Matta 13:52
content: 52 Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Saboda haka duk malamin dokokin da ya horu game da koyarwar mulkin sama, yana kama da maigida wanda yakan fitar daga ɗakin ajiyarsa sababbin dukiya da kuma tsofaffi.”

title: Matta 13:53
content: 53 Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama ba da waɗannan misalai, sai ya ci gaba daga can.

title: Matta 13:54
content: 54 Yana isowa garinsa, sai ya fara koya wa mutane a cikin majami’arsu, suka kuwa yi mamaki. Suka yi ta tambaya suna cewa, “Ina wannan mutum ya sami irin wannan hikima da kuma ayyukan banmamaki haka?

title: Matta 13:55
content: 55 Wannan ba shi ne ɗan kafinta nan ba? Ba mahaifiyarsa ba ce Maryamu, ’yan’uwansa kuma Yaƙub, Yusuf, Siman da Yahuda ba?

title: Matta 13:56
content: 56 Duk ’yan’uwansa mata kuma ba tare da mu suke ba? To, a ina wannan mutum ya sami dukan waɗannan abubuwa?”

title: Matta 13:57
content: 57 Sai suka ji haushinsa. Amma Yesu ya ce musu, “Sai a garinsa da kuma a gidansa na kaɗai annabi ba ya samun girma.”

title: Matta 13:58
content: 58 Bai kuwa yi abubuwan banmamaki da yawa a can ba saboda rashin bangaskiyarsu.

title: Matta 14:1
content: 1 A lokacin nan sarki Hiridus ya ji labarin Yesu,

title: Matta 14:2
content: 2 sai ya ce wa fadawansa, “Wannan Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne; ya tashi daga matattu! Shi ya sa abubuwan banmamakin nan suke faruwa ta wurinsa.”

title: Matta 14:3
content: 3 To, dā Hiridus ya kama Yohanna ya daure, ya kuma sa shi cikin kurkuku saboda Hiridiyas, matar ɗan’uwansa Filibus,

title: Matta 14:4
content: 4 gama Yohanna ya dinga ce masa, “Ba daidai ba ne ka aure ta.”

title: Matta 14:5
content: 5 Hiridus ya so yă kashe Yohanna, amma yana jin tsoron mutane, don sun ɗauka shi annabi ne.

title: Matta 14:6
content: 6 A bikin tuna da ranar haihuwar Hiridus, diyar Hiridiyas ta yi musu rawa ta kuma gamsar da Hiridus ƙwarai,

title: Matta 14:7
content: 7 har ya yi alkawari da rantsuwa cewa zai ba ta duk abin da ta roƙa.

title: Matta 14:8
content: 8 Da mahaifiyarta ta zuga ta, sai ta ce, “Ba ni a cikin kwanon nan, kan Yohanna Mai Baftisma.”

title: Matta 14:9
content: 9 Sarki ya yi baƙin ciki, amma saboda rantsuwarsa da kuma baƙinsa, sai ya ba da umarni a ba ta abin da ta roƙa

title: Matta 14:10
content: 10 ya kuma sa aka yanke kan Yohanna a kurkuku.

title: Matta 14:11
content: 11 Aka kawo kansa cikin kwano aka ba yarinyar, ita kuma ta kai wa mahaifiyarta.

title: Matta 14:12
content: 12 Almajiran Yohanna suka zo suka ɗauki gawarsa suka binne. Sa’an nan suka je suka gaya wa Yesu.

title: Matta 14:13
content: 13 Sa’ad da Yesu ya ji abin da ya faru, sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya janye shi kaɗai zuwa wani wuri inda ba kowa. Da jin haka, taron mutane suka bi shi da ƙafa daga garuruwa.

title: Matta 14:14
content: 14 Da Yesu ya sauka ya kuma ga taro mai yawa, sai ya ji tausayinsu ya kuma warkar da marasa lafiyarsu.

title: Matta 14:15
content: 15 Da yamma ta yi, sai almajiransa suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Wurin nan fa ba kowa, ga shi kuma rana ta kusa fāɗuwa. Ka sallami taron don su shiga ƙauyuka su nemi wa kansu abinci.”

title: Matta 14:16
content: 16 Yesu ya amsa, “Ba su bukata su tafi. Ku ku ba su wani abu su ci.”

title: Matta 14:17
content: 17 Suka ce, “Burodi biyar da kifi biyu ne kawai muke da su a nan.”

title: Matta 14:18
content: 18 Ya ce, “Ku kawo mini su a nan.”

title: Matta 14:19
content: 19 Sai ya umarci mutanen su zazzauna a kan ciyawa. Da ya ɗauki burodi biyar da kifin biyun nan ya dubi sama, ya yi godiya ya kuma kakkarya burodin. Sa’an nan ya ba wa almajiransa, almajiran kuwa suka ba wa mutane.

title: Matta 14:20
content: 20 Duk suka ci suka ƙoshi, almajiran kuwa suka kwashe ragowar gutsattsarin cike da kwanduna goma sha biyu.

title: Matta 14:21
content: 21 Yawan waɗanda suka ci, sun yi wajen maza dubu biyar, ban da mata da yara.

title: Matta 14:22
content: 22 Nan da nan Yesu ya sa almajiran su shiga jirgin ruwa su sha gabansa, su haye zuwa ɗayan hayin, yayinda shi kuma yă sallami taron.

title: Matta 14:23
content: 23 Bayan ya sallame su, sai ya haura bisan gefen dutse shi kaɗai don yă yi addu’a. Da yamma ta yi, yana can shi kaɗai,

title: Matta 14:24
content: 24 jirgin ruwan kuwa ya riga ya yi nesa da gaci, yana fama da raƙuman ruwa domin iska tana gāba da shi.

title: Matta 14:25
content: 25 Wajen tsaro na huɗu na dare, sai Yesu ya nufe su, yana takawa a kan tafkin.

title: Matta 14:26
content: 26 Sa’ad da almajiran suka gan shi yana takawa a kan tafkin, sai tsoro ya kama su. Suka yi ihu don tsoro suka ce, “Fatalwa ce.”

title: Matta 14:27
content: 27 Amma nan da nan Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku yi ƙarfin hali! Ni ne. Kada ku ji tsoro.”

title: Matta 14:28
content: 28 Sai Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji in kai ne ka ce mini in zo wurinka a kan ruwan.”

title: Matta 14:29
content: 29 Ya ce, “Zo.” Sai Bitrus ya fita daga jirgin ruwan, ya taka a kan ruwan ya nufe wajen Yesu.

title: Matta 14:30
content: 30 Amma da ya ga haukar iskar, sai ya ji tsoro, ya kuma fara nutsewa, sai ya yi ihu ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka cece ni!”

title: Matta 14:31
content: 31 Nan da nan Yesu ya miƙa hannu ya kamo shi ya ce, “Kai mai ƙarancin bangaskiya, don me ka yi shakka?”

title: Matta 14:32
content: 32 Da suka hau jirgin ruwan, sai iskar ta kwanta.

title: Matta 14:33
content: 33 Waɗanda suke cikin jirgin ruwan kuwa suka yi masa sujada, suna cewa, “Gaskiya kai Ɗan Allah ne.”

title: Matta 14:34
content: 34 Sa’ad da suka haye, sai suka sauka a Gennesaret.

title: Matta 14:35
content: 35 Da mutanen wurin suka gane da Yesu, sai suka kai labari a ko’ina a ƙauyukan da suke kewaye. Mutane suka kawo masa dukan marasa lafiyarsu

title: Matta 14:36
content: 36 suka kuwa roƙe shi yă bar marasa lafiya su taɓa ko da gefen rigarsa kawai, duk waɗanda suka taɓa shi kuwa suka warke.

title: Matta 15:1
content: 1 Sa’an nan waɗansu Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka zo wurin Yesu daga Urushalima suka yi tambaya suka ce,

title: Matta 15:2
content: 2 “Me ya sa almajiranka suke karya al’adun dattawa? Ba sa wanke hannuwansu kafin su ci abinci!”

title: Matta 15:3
content: 3 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku ma me ya sa kuke karya dokar Allah saboda al’adarku?

title: Matta 15:4
content: 4 Gama Allah ya ce, ‘Ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka, kuma duk wanda ya zagi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa dole a kashe shi.’

title: Matta 15:5
content: 5 Amma ku kukan ce, in wani ya ce wa mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, ‘Duk taimakon da dā ya kamata za ku samu daga gare ni an ba wa Allah,’

title: Matta 15:6
content: 6 ba zai ‘girmama mahaifinsa’ da shi ba. Ta haka kun yi banza da maganar Allah saboda al’adarku.

title: Matta 15:7
content: 7 Ku munafukai! Daidai ne Ishaya ya yi annabci a kanku da ya ce,

title: Matta 15:8
content: 8 “ ‘Waɗannan mutane da baki kawai suke girmama ni, amma zukatansu suna nesa da ni.

title: Matta 15:9
content: 9 A banza suke mini sujada, koyarwarsu, dokoki ne kawai da mutane suke koyarwa.’ ”

title: Matta 15:10
content: 10 Sai Yesu ya kira taron wurinsa ya ce, “Ku saurara ku kuma gane.

title: Matta 15:11
content: 11 Abin da yake shiga bakin mutum ba ya ƙazantar da shi, sai dai abin da yake fitowa daga bakinsa, shi ne yake ƙazantar da shi.”

title: Matta 15:12
content: 12 Sai almajiran suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Ka san cewa Farisiyawa ba su ji daɗi sa’ad da suka ji wannan ba?”

title: Matta 15:13
content: 13 Ya amsa ya ce, “Duk tsiron da Ubana na sama bai shuka ba, za a tumɓuke shi daga saiwoyi.

title: Matta 15:14
content: 14 Ku ƙyale su, ai, makafin jagorai ne. In makaho ya yi wa makaho jagora, dukansu za su fāɗa a rami.”

title: Matta 15:15
content: 15 Bitrus ya ce, “Ka bayyana mana wannan misali.”

title: Matta 15:16
content: 16 Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Har yanzu ba ku gane ba ne?

title: Matta 15:17
content: 17 Ba ku gane cewa duk abin da ya shiga baki yakan wuce ciki ne daga nan kuma yă fita daga jiki ba?

title: Matta 15:18
content: 18 Amma abubuwan da suke fitowa ta baki suna fitowa ne daga zuciya, su ne kuma suke ƙazantar da mutum.

title: Matta 15:19
content: 19 Gama daga zuciya ne mugayen tunani, kisankai, zina, fasikanci, sata, shaidar ƙarya, ɓatan suna, suka fitowa.

title: Matta 15:20
content: 20 Waɗannan su ne suke ƙazantar da mutum; amma cin abinci ba tare da wanke hannuwa ba, ba ya ƙazantar da mutum.”

title: Matta 15:21
content: 21 Barin wurin ke nan, sai Yesu ya janye zuwa yankin Taya da Sidon.

title: Matta 15:22
content: 22 Wata mutuniyar Kan’ana daga wajajen ta zo wurinsa, tana ihu tana cewa, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai! ’Yata tana shan wahala ƙwarai daga aljanin da yake cikinta.”

title: Matta 15:23
content: 23 Yesu bai ce mata uffam ba. Saboda haka almajiransa suka zo wurinsa suka roƙe shi suka ce, “Ka kore ta tă tafi, tana ta binmu tana damunmu da ihu.”

title: Matta 15:24
content: 24 Ya amsa ya ce, “An aiko ni wurin ɓatattun tumakin Isra’ila ne kaɗai.”

title: Matta 15:25
content: 25 Sai macen ta zo ta durƙusa a gabansa ta ce, “Ubangiji, ka taimake ni!”

title: Matta 15:26
content: 26 Ya amsa ya ce, “Ba daidai ba ne a ɗauki abincin yara a jefa wa karnukansu.”

title: Matta 15:27
content: 27 Ta amsa, ta ce, “I, Ubangiji, amma karnuka ma sukan ci gutsattsarin da sukan fāɗi daga teburin maigidansu.”

title: Matta 15:28
content: 28 Sa’an nan Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mace, kina da bangaskiya mai yawa! An biya miki bukatarki.” ’Yarta kuwa ta warke nan take.

title: Matta 15:29
content: 29 Yesu ya tashi daga nan ya bi ta gefen Tekun Galili. Sa’an nan ya haura gefen wani dutse ya zauna.

title: Matta 15:30
content: 30 Taron mutane mai girma kuwa suka zo wurinsa, suna kawo masa guragu, makafi, shanyayyu, kurame da dai waɗansu da yawa, suka kuwa kwantar da su a gabansa; ya kuma warkar da su.

title: Matta 15:31
content: 31 Mutanen kuwa suka yi mamaki sa’ad da suka ga kurame suna magana, shanyayyu suna samun lafiya, guragu suna takawa, makafi kuma suna ganin gari. Sai suka yabi Allah na Isra’ila.

title: Matta 15:32
content: 32 Yesu ya kira almajiransa wurinsa ya ce, “Ina jin tausayin mutanen nan; gama kwana uku ke nan suke tare da ni ba abin da za su ci. Ba na so in sallame su da yunwa, don kada su kāsa a hanya.”

title: Matta 15:33
content: 33 Sai almajiransa suka amsa suka ce, “Ina za mu sami isashen burodi a wannan wurin da babu kowa mu ciyar da irin taron nan?”

title: Matta 15:34
content: 34 Yesu ya tambaye su, “Burodi guda nawa kuke da shi?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Guda bakwai da ’yan ƙananan kifaye.”

title: Matta 15:35
content: 35 Ya sa taron su zazzauna a ƙasa.

title: Matta 15:36
content: 36 Sa’an nan ya ɗauki burodi guda bakwai da kuma kifayen nan, da ya yi godiya, sai ya kakkarya su ya ba wa almajiran, su kuma suka ba wa mutane.

title: Matta 15:37
content: 37 Duk kuwa suka ci, suka ƙoshi. Daga baya almajiran suka kwashe ragowar gutsattsarin cike da kwanduna bakwai.

title: Matta 15:38
content: 38 Yawan waɗanda suka ci kuwa, maza dubu huɗu ne, ban da mata da yara.

title: Matta 15:39
content: 39 Bayan Yesu ya sallami taron, sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya tafi wajajen Magadan.

title: Matta 16:1
content: 1 Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa suka zo don su gwada Yesu ta wurin neman yă nuna musu wata alama daga sama.

title: Matta 16:2
content: 2 Ya amsa ya ce, “Sa’ad da yamma ta yi, kukan ce, ‘Yanayi zai yi kyau, gama sararin sama ya yi ja,’

title: Matta 16:3
content: 3 da safe kuma, ku ce, ‘Yau kam za a yi hadari, gama sararin sama ya yi ja, ya kuma ɓata fuska.’ Kun san yadda za ku fassara yanayin sararin sama, amma ba kwa iya fassarar alamun lokuta.

title: Matta 16:4
content: 4 Wannan mugu da mazinacin zamani yana neman wani abin banmamaki, amma ba wata alamar da za a nuna wa wannan zamani sai dai ta Yunana.” Sai Yesu ya bar su ya tafi abinsa.

title: Matta 16:5
content: 5 Da suka ƙetare tafkin, almajiran sun manta su riƙe burodi.

title: Matta 16:6
content: 6 Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku yi hankali, ku yi taka zallan da yistin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa.”

title: Matta 16:7
content: 7 Sai suka fara tattaunawa da junansu suna cewa, “Ko don ba mu kawo burodi ba ne.”

title: Matta 16:8
content: 8 Sane da abin da suke zance, sai Yesu ya ce, “Ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya, don me kuke magana da junanku a kan ba ku zo da burodi ba?

title: Matta 16:9
content: 9 Har yanzu ba ku gane ba ne? Ba ku tuna da gurasa biyar ɗin nan na mutum dubu biyar ba? Kwando nawa kuka tattara cike?

title: Matta 16:10
content: 10 Ko kuma burodi bakwai nan na mutum dubu huɗu, cikakku manyan kwanduna nawa kuka ɗauka?

title: Matta 16:11
content: 11 Yaya kuka kāsa gane cewa ba zancen burodi nake yi ba? Sai dai ku yi hankali da yistin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa.”

title: Matta 16:12
content: 12 Sa’an nan suka gane ba cewa yake musu su yi hankali da yistin da ake amfani da shi a burodi ba ne, sai dai su yi hankali da koyarwar Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa ne.

title: Matta 16:13
content: 13 Sa’ad da Yesu ya zo yankin Kaisariya Filibbi, sai ya tambayi almajiransa ya ce, “Wa mutane suke ce da Ɗan Mutum?”

title: Matta 16:14
content: 14 Suka amsa, “Waɗansu suna ce Yohanna Mai Baftisma; waɗansu kuma suna ce annabi Iliya; har wa yau waɗansu suna ce Irmiya ne ko kuma ɗaya daga cikin annabawa.”

title: Matta 16:15
content: 15 Ya tambaye su, “Amma ku fa, wane ne ni a ganinku?”

title: Matta 16:16
content: 16 Siman Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah mai rai.”

title: Matta 16:17
content: 17 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mai albarka ne kai Siman ɗan Yunana, gama ba mutum ne ya bayyana maka wannan ba, sai dai Ubana da yake cikin sama.

title: Matta 16:18
content: 18 Ina kuwa gaya maka, kai ne Bitrus, a kan wannan dutse zan gina ikkilisiyata, kuma ƙofofin Hades ba za su rinjaye ta ba.

title: Matta 16:19
content: 19 Zan ba ka mabuɗan mulkin sama; kome ka daure a duniya zai zama a daure a sama, kome kuma ka kunce a duniya zai zama a kunce a sama.”

title: Matta 16:20
content: 20 Sa’an nan ya gargaɗe almajiransa cewa kada su faɗa wa kowa shi ne Kiristi.

title: Matta 16:21
content: 21 Tun daga wannan lokaci Yesu ya fara bayyana wa almajiransa cewa dole yă tafi Urushalima yă sha wahaloli da yawa a hannun dattawa, manyan firistoci da kuma malaman dokoki, dole a kashe shi, a rana ta uku kuma a tashe shi.

title: Matta 16:22
content: 22 Bitrus ya ja shi gefe ya fara tsawata masa yana cewa, “Sam, Ubangiji! Wannan ba zai taɓa faruwa da kai ba!”

title: Matta 16:23
content: 23 Yesu ya juya ya ce wa Bitrus, “Rabu da ni, Shaiɗan! Kai abin sa tuntuɓe ne a gare ni; ba ka tunanin al’amuran Allah, sai dai al’amuran mutane.”

title: Matta 16:24
content: 24 Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Duk mai son bina, dole yă ƙi kansa, yă ɗauki gicciyensa, yă bi ni.

title: Matta 16:25
content: 25 Gama duk mai son ceton ransa zai rasa shi, amma duk wanda ya rasa ransa saboda ni, zai same shi.

title: Matta 16:26
content: 26 Me mutum zai amfana in ya sami duniya duka, amma ya rasa ransa? Ko kuwa me mutum zai bayar a bakin ransa?

title: Matta 16:27
content: 27 Gama Ɗan Mutum zai zo cikin ɗaukakar Ubansa, tare da mala’ikunsa, sa’an nan zai ba wa kowane mutum lada gwargwadon abin da ya yi.

title: Matta 16:28
content: 28 “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, akwai waɗansu da suke tsaitsaye a nan da ba za su mutu ba sai sun ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa cikin mulkinsa.”

title: Matta 17:1
content: 1 Bayan kwana shida, sai Yesu ya ɗauki Bitrus, Yaƙub da Yohanna ɗan’uwan Yaƙub, ya kai su kan wani dutse mai tsawo, su kaɗai.

title: Matta 17:2
content: 2 A can aka sāke kamanninsa a gabansu. Fuskarsa ta haskaka kamar rana, tufafinsa kuwa suka zama fari fat suna walƙiya.

title: Matta 17:3
content: 3 Nan take sai ga Musa da Iliya suka bayyana a gabansu, suna magana da Yesu.

title: Matta 17:4
content: 4 Sai Bitrus ya ce wa Yesu, “Ubangiji, ya yi kyau da muke nan. In kana so, sai in kafa bukkoki uku, ɗaya dominka, ɗaya domin Musa, ɗaya kuma domin Iliya.”

title: Matta 17:5
content: 5 Yayinda yake cikin magana, sai wani girgije mai haske ya rufe su, sai wata murya daga cikin girgijen ta ce, “Wannan Ɗana ne, wanda nake ƙauna; wanda kuma nake jin daɗinsa ƙwarai. Ku saurare shi!”

title: Matta 17:6
content: 6 Sa’ad da almajiran suka ji haka, sai suka fāɗi ƙasa rubda ciki, a firgice.

title: Matta 17:7
