content: 7 Amma Yesu ya zo ya taɓa su ya ce, “Ku tashi, kada ku ji tsoro.”

title: Matta 17:8
content: 8 Da suka ɗaga kai, ba su ga kowa ba sai Yesu kaɗai.

title: Matta 17:9
content: 9 Suna cikin gangarowa daga dutsen ke nan, sai Yesu ya umarce su cewa, “Kada ku faɗa wa kowa abin da kuka gani, sai bayan an tā da Ɗan Mutum daga matattu.”

title: Matta 17:10
content: 10 Almajiran suka tambaye shi suka ce, “To, me ya sa malaman dokoki suke cewa, dole sai Iliya ya fara zuwa?”

title: Matta 17:11
content: 11 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Tabbatacce, Iliya zai zo, zai kuma gyara dukan abubuwa.

title: Matta 17:12
content: 12 Amma ina faɗa muku, Iliya ya riga ya zo, ba su kuwa gane shi ba, amma suka yi masa duk abin da suka ga dama. Haka ma Ɗan Mutum zai sha wahala a hannunsu.”

title: Matta 17:13
content: 13 Sa’an nan almajiran suka gane cewa yana musu zancen Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne.

title: Matta 17:14
content: 14 Da suka isa wajen taron, sai wani mutum ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa.

title: Matta 17:15
content: 15 Ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka yi wa ɗana jinƙai. Yana da farfaɗiya yana kuma shan wahala ƙwarai. Ya sha fāɗuwa cikin wuta ko ruwa.

title: Matta 17:16
content: 16 Na kuma kawo shi wurin almajiranka, amma ba su iya warkar da shi ba.”

title: Matta 17:17
content: 17 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ya ku zamani marasa bangaskiya da kuma masu taurinkai, har yaushe zan kasance tare da ku? Har yaushe kuma zan yi haƙuri da ku? Kawo mini yaron a nan.”

title: Matta 17:18
content: 18 Yesu ya tsawata wa aljanin, ya kuwa rabu da yaron, nan take yaron ya warke.

title: Matta 17:19
content: 19 Sa’an nan almajiran suka zo wurin Yesu a ɓoye suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Me ya sa ba mu iya fitar da aljanin ba?”

title: Matta 17:20
content: 20 Ya amsa ya ce, “Saboda kuna da ƙarancin bangaskiya sosai. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in kuna da bangaskiyar da take ƙanƙanuwa kamar ƙwayar mustad, za ku iya ce wa wannan dutse, ‘Matsa daga nan zuwa can,’ zai kuwa matsa. Babu abin da zai gagare ku.”

title: Matta 17:22
content: 22 Da suka taru a Galili, sai ya ce musu, “Za a bashe Ɗan Mutum, a hannun mutane.

title: Matta 17:23
content: 23 Za su kashe shi, a rana ta uku kuma za a tashe shi.” Almajiran kuwa suka cika da baƙin ciki.

title: Matta 17:24
content: 24 Bayan Yesu da almajiransa suka isa Kafarnahum, sai masu karɓan harajin rabin shekel suka zo wurin Bitrus suka ce, “Malaminku ba ya biyan harajin haikali ne?”

title: Matta 17:25
content: 25 Ya amsa ya ce “I, yana biya.” Da Bitrus ya shiga gida, Yesu ne ya fara magana. Ya ce masa, “Me ka gani, Siman? Daga wurin wane ne sarakunan duniya suke karɓar kuɗin shiga da kuma haraji, daga wurin ’ya’yansu ne ko kuwa daga wurin waɗansu?”

title: Matta 17:26
content: 26 Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Daga wurin waɗansu.” Yesu ya ce masa, “Wato, an ɗauke wa ’ya’yan ke nan.

title: Matta 17:27
content: 27 Amma don kada mu ɓata musu rai, ka je tafki ka jefa ƙugiyarka. Ka ɗauki kifin da ka fara kama; ka buɗe bakinsa, za ka sami shekel guda. Ka kawo ka ba su, harajina da naka ke nan.”

title: Matta 18:1
content: 1 A lokacin nan sai almajirai suka zo wurin Yesu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Wane ne mafi girma a mulkin sama?”

title: Matta 18:2
content: 2 Sai ya kira ƙaramin yaro ya sa shi yă tsaya a tsakiyarsu.

title: Matta 18:3
content: 3 Sai ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in ba kun canja kuka zama kamar ƙananan yara ba, labudda, ba za ku shiga mulkin sama ba.

title: Matta 18:4
content: 4 Saboda haka, duk wanda ya ƙasƙantar da kansa kamar wannan yaro, shi ne mafi girma a mulkin sama.

title: Matta 18:5
content: 5 Duk kuma wanda ya karɓi ƙaramin yaro kamar wannan a cikin sunana ya karɓe ni ne.

title: Matta 18:6
content: 6 “Amma duk wanda ya sa ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan da suka gaskata da ni ya yi zunubi, zai fiye masa a rataya babban dutsen niƙa a wuyarsa, a kuma nutsar da shi a zurfin teku.

title: Matta 18:7
content: 7 Kaiton duniya saboda abubuwan da suke sa mutane su yi zunubi! Dole irin waɗannan abubuwa su zo, sai dai kaiton mutumin da ya zama sanadin kawo su!

title: Matta 18:8
content: 8 In hannunka ko ƙafarka yana sa ka zunubi, yanke shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka shiga rai da hannu ko ƙafa ɗaya da hannuwa biyu ko ƙafafu biyu da a jefar da kai cikin madawwamiyar wuta da hannuwa biyu ko ƙafafu biyu.

title: Matta 18:9
content: 9 In kuma idonka yana sa ka zunubi, ƙwaƙule shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka shiga rai da ido ɗaya, da ka shiga jahannama ta wuta da idanunka biyu.

title: Matta 18:10
content: 10 “Ku lura, kada ku rena ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ƙanana. Gama ina faɗa muku mala’ikunsu a sama kullum suna duban fuskar Ubana da yake cikin sama.

title: Matta 18:12
content: 12 “Me kuka gani? In wani yana da tumaki ɗari, sai ɗaya daga cikinsu ta ɓace, ba sai yă bar tasa’in da taran a kan tuddai yă je neman guda ɗayan da ta ɓace ba?

title: Matta 18:13
content: 13 In kuwa ya same ta, ina gaya muku gaskiya, zai yi murna saboda ɗayan fiye da tasa’in da taran da ba su ɓace ba.

title: Matta 18:14
content: 14 Haka ma Ubanku da yake cikin sama ba ya so ko ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan yă ɓace.

title: Matta 18:15
content: 15 “In ɗan’uwanka ya yi maka laifi, ka je ka nuna masa laifinsa, tsakaninku biyu kaɗai. In ya saurare ka, ka maido da ɗan’uwanka ke nan.

title: Matta 18:16
content: 16 Amma in bai saurare ka ba, ka je tare da mutum ɗaya ko biyu, domin ‘a tabbatar da kowace magana a bakin shaidu biyu ko uku.’

title: Matta 18:17
content: 17 In kuwa ya ƙi yă saurare su, sai ka gaya wa ikkilisiya; in kuma ya ƙi yă saurari ikkilisiya ma, ka yi da shi kamar marar sanin Allah ko mai karɓar haraji.

title: Matta 18:18
content: 18 “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da kuka daure a duniya, za a daure a sama, duk kuma abin da kuka kunce a duniya, za a kunce shi a sama.

title: Matta 18:19
content: 19 “Har wa yau, ina gaya muku cewa in mutum biyu a cikinku a duniya suka yarda su roƙi wani abu, Ubana da yake cikin sama zai yi muku.

title: Matta 18:20
content: 20 Gama inda mutum biyu ko uku suka taru cikin sunana, a can ma ina tare da su.”

title: Matta 18:21
content: 21 Sai Bitrus ya zo wurin Yesu ya yi masa tambaya ya ce, “Ubangiji, sau nawa zan yafe wa ɗan’uwana sa’ad da ya yi mini zunubi? Har sau bakwai?”

title: Matta 18:22
content: 22 Yesu amsa ya ce, “Ina gaya maka, ba sau bakwai ba, amma sau saba’in da bakwai.

title: Matta 18:23
content: 23 “Saboda haka, mulkin sama yana kama da wani sarki wanda ya so yă yi ƙididdigar dukiyarsa da take a hannun bayinsa.

title: Matta 18:24
content: 24 Da ya fara ƙididdigar, sai aka kawo masa wani wanda yake bin bashin talenti dubu goma.

title: Matta 18:25
content: 25 Da yake bai iya biya ba, sai maigida ya umarta a sayar da shi da matarsa da yaransa da kuma duk abin da yake da shi, a biya bashin.

title: Matta 18:26
content: 26 “Bawan ya durƙusa a gabansa. Ya yi roƙo ya ce, ‘Ka yi mini haƙuri, zan biya ka ƙaf.’

title: Matta 18:27
content: 27 Maigidan bawan ya ji tausayinsa, ya yafe masa bashin, ya kuma sake shi.

title: Matta 18:28
content: 28 “Amma da wannan bawa ya fita, sai ya gamu da wani abokin bautarsa wanda yake binsa bashin dinari ɗari. Sai ya cafke shi, ya shaƙe shi a wuya yana cewa, ‘Biya ni abin da nake binka!’

title: Matta 18:29
content: 29 “Wannan abokin bautarsa ya durƙusa ya roƙe shi, ‘Ka yi mini haƙuri, zan biya ka.’

title: Matta 18:30
content: 30 “Amma ya ƙi. A maimako, sai ya je ya sa aka jefa shi a kurkuku, har yă biya bashin.

title: Matta 18:31
content: 31 Sa’ad da sauran bayin suka ga abin da ya faru, abin ya ɓata musu rai ƙwarai, sai suka tafi suka faɗa wa maigidansu dukan abin da ya faru.

title: Matta 18:32
content: 32 “Sai maigidan ya kira wannan bawa. Ya ce, ‘Kai mugun bawa, na yafe duk bashin da nake binka domin ka roƙe ni.

title: Matta 18:33
content: 33 Ashe, bai kamata kai ma ka ji tausayin abokin bautarka yadda na yi maka ba?’

title: Matta 18:34
content: 34 Cikin fushi, maigidan ya miƙa shi ga ma’aikatan kurkuku su gwada masa azaba, har yă biya dukan bashin da ake binsa.

title: Matta 18:35
content: 35 “Haka Ubana da yake cikin sama zai yi da kowannenku, in ba ku yafe wa ’yan’uwanku daga zuciyarku ba.”

title: Matta 19:1
content: 1 Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama faɗin waɗannan abubuwa, sai ya bar Galili, ya tafi yankin Yahudiya a ɗaya gefen Urdun.

title: Matta 19:2
content: 2 Taron mutane mai yawa suka bi shi, ya kuwa warkar da su a can.

title: Matta 19:3
content: 3 Waɗansu Farisiyawa suka zo wurinsa don su gwada shi. Suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Daidai ne mutum yă saki matarsa saboda wani dalili da kuma a kan kowane dalili?”

title: Matta 19:4
content: 4 Ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ku taɓa karantawa ba ne cewa, a farkon halitta, Mahalicci ‘ya yi su namiji da ta mace,’

title: Matta 19:5
content: 5 ya kuma ce, ‘Saboda wannan dalili, namiji zai bar mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa yă manne wa matarsa, biyun kuwa su zama jiki guda’?

title: Matta 19:6
content: 6 Ta haka, ba sa ƙara zama biyu, sai dai ɗaya. Saboda haka abin da Allah ya haɗa fa, kada mutum yă raba.”

title: Matta 19:7
content: 7 Suka yi tambaya, suka ce, “To, me ya sa Musa ya umarta cewa mutum yă ba wa matarsa takardar saki, yă kuma kore ta?”

title: Matta 19:8
content: 8 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Musa ya ba ku izini ku saki matanku saboda taurin zuciyarku ne. Amma ba haka yake ba daga farko.

title: Matta 19:9
content: 9 Ina faɗa muku cewa duk wanda ya saki matarsa, sai dai a kan rashin aminci a cikin aure, ya kuwa auri wata, ya yi zina ke nan.”

title: Matta 19:10
content: 10 Almajiran suka ce masa, “In haka yake tsakanin miji da mata, ashe, ya ma fi kyau kada a yi aure.”

title: Matta 19:11
content: 11 Yesu ya ce, “Ba kowa ba ne zai yarda da wannan magana, sai dai waɗanda aka yarda musu.

title: Matta 19:12
content: 12 Gama waɗansu bābānni ne domin haka aka haife su; waɗansu kuwa mutane ne suka mai da su haka; waɗansu kuma sun ƙi aure ne saboda mulkin sama. Duk mai iya ɗaukar wannan yă ɗauka.”

title: Matta 19:13
content: 13 Sa’an nan aka kawo yara ƙanana wurin Yesu don yă ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, yă kuma yi musu addu’a. Amma almajirai suka tsawata wa waɗanda suka kawo su.

title: Matta 19:14
content: 14 Yesu ya ce, “Ku bar yara ƙanana su zo wurina, kada ku hana su, gama mulkin sama na irin waɗannan ne.”

title: Matta 19:15
content: 15 Sa’ad da ya ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, sai ya tafi abinsa.

title: Matta 19:16
content: 16 To, fa, sai ga wani ya zo wurin Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Malam, wane abu mai kyau ne ya zama mini dole in yi don in sami rai madawwami?”

title: Matta 19:17
content: 17 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kake tambayata game da abin da yake mai kyau? Akwai Mai kyau Ɗaya kaɗai. In kana so ka sami rai madawwami, ka kiyaye dokokin nan.”

title: Matta 19:18
content: 18 Mutumin ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Waɗanne?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “ ‘Kada ka yi kisankai, kada ka yi zina, kada ka yi sata, kada ka yi shaidar ƙarya,

title: Matta 19:19
content: 19 ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka,’ ka kuma ‘ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’”

title: Matta 19:20
content: 20 Saurayin ya ce, “Duk waɗannan na kiyaye. Me kuma ya rage mini?”

title: Matta 19:21
content: 21 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “In kana so ka zama cikakke, ka je, ka sayar da dukan dukiyarka ka kuma ba matalauta, za ka kuwa sami dukiya a sama. Sa’an nan ka zo, ka bi ni.”

title: Matta 19:22
content: 22 Da saurayin ya ji haka, sai ya tafi rai a ɓace, don yana da arziki sosai.

title: Matta 19:23
content: 23 Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, yana da wuya mai arziki yă shiga mulkin sama.

title: Matta 19:24
content: 24 Har wa yau ina gaya muku, zai fi sauƙi raƙumi yă shiga ta kafar allura, da mai arziki yă shiga mulkin Allah.”

title: Matta 19:25
content: 25 Sa’ad da almajiran suka ji wannan, sai suka yi mamaki ƙwarai. Suka yi tambaya suka ce, “To, wa zai sami ceto ke nan?”

title: Matta 19:26
content: 26 Yesu ya kalle su ya ce, “Ga mutum kam, wannan ba ya yiwuwa, amma ga Allah kuwa, dukan abubuwa masu yiwuwa ne.”

title: Matta 19:27
content: 27 Sai Bitrus ya amsa masa, “Ga shi mun bar kome don mu bi ka! Me za mu samu ke nan?”

title: Matta 19:28
content: 28 Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, a lokacin sabunta dukan kome, sa’ad da Ɗan Mutum ya zauna a kan kursiyinsa mai daraja, ku da kuka bi ni, ku ma za ku zauna a kan kursiyoyi goma sha biyu, kuna yi wa kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila shari’a.

title: Matta 19:29
content: 29 Duk kuma wanda ya bar gidaje ko ’yan’uwa maza ko ’yan’uwa mata ko mahaifi ko mahaifiya ko yara ko gonaki, saboda ni, zai sami abin da ya fi haka riɓi ɗari, yă kuma gāji rai madawwami.

title: Matta 19:30
content: 30 Amma da yawa da suke na farko, za su zama na ƙarshe, da yawa kuma da suke na ƙarshe, za su zama na farko.

title: Matta 20:1
content: 1 “Mulkin sama yana kama da wani mai gona, wanda ya fita da sassafe don yă yi hayar mutane su yi aiki a gonar inabinsa.

title: Matta 20:2
content: 2 Ya yarda yă biya su dinari guda a yini, sai ya tura su gonar inabinsa.

title: Matta 20:3
content: 3 “Wajen sa’a ta uku, ya fita sai ya ga waɗansu suna tsattsaye a bakin kasuwa ba sa kome.

title: Matta 20:4
content: 4 Ya ce musu, ‘Ku ma ku tafi gonar inabina ku yi aiki, zan kuwa biya ku abin da ya dace.’

title: Matta 20:5
content: 5 Saboda haka suka tafi. “Ya sāke fita a sa’a ta shida da kuma sa’a ta tara, ya sāke yin haka.

title: Matta 20:6
content: 6 Wajen sa’a ta goma sha ɗaya, ya sāke fita, ya tarar da waɗansu har yanzu suna tsattsaye. Ya tambaye su, ‘Don me kuke yini tsattsaye a nan ba kwa kome?’

title: Matta 20:7
content: 7 “Suka amsa, ‘Don ba wanda ya ɗauke mu aiki.’ “Ya ce musu, ‘Ku ma ku je ku yi aiki a gonar inabina.’

title: Matta 20:8
content: 8 “Sa’ad da yamma ta yi, sai mai gonar inabin ya ce wa wakilinsa, ‘Kira ma’aikatan, ka biya su hakkin aikinsu, fara daga waɗanda aka ɗauke su a ƙarshe har zuwa na farko.’

title: Matta 20:9
content: 9 “Ma’aikatan da ka ɗauka wajen sa’a ta goma sha ɗaya suka zo, kowannensu kuwa ya karɓi dinari guda.

title: Matta 20:10
content: 10 Saboda haka da waɗanda aka ɗauka da fari suka zo, sun zaci za su sami fiye da haka. Amma kowannensu ma ya karɓi dinari guda.

title: Matta 20:11
content: 11 Sa’ad da suka karɓa, sai suka fara yin gunaguni a kan mai gonar.

title: Matta 20:12
content: 12 Suna cewa, ‘Waɗannan mutanen da aka ɗauka a ƙarshe sun yi aikin sa’a ɗaya ne kawai, ka kuma mai da su daidai da mu da muka yini muna faman aiki, muka kuma sha zafin rana.’

title: Matta 20:13
content: 13 “Amma ya amsa wa ɗayansu ya ce, ‘Aboki, ban cuce ka ba. Ba ka yarda ka yi aiki a kan dinari guda ba?

title: Matta 20:14
content: 14 Ka karɓi hakkinka ka tafi. Ni na ga damar ba waɗannan na ƙarshe daidai da yadda na ba ka.

title: Matta 20:15
content: 15 Ba ni da ikon yin abin da na ga dama da kuɗina ne? Ko kana kishi saboda ni mai kyauta ne?’

title: Matta 20:16
content: 16 “Saboda haka fa, na ƙarshe za su zama na farko, na farko kuma su zama na ƙarshe.”

title: Matta 20:17
content: 17 To, da Yesu yana haurawa zuwa Urushalima, sai ya ja almajiran nan goma sha biyu gefe, ya ce musu,

title: Matta 20:18
content: 18 “Za mu haura zuwa Urushalima, za a kuma bashe Ɗan Mutum ga manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki. Za su yi masa hukuncin kisa

title: Matta 20:19
content: 19 za su kuma bashe shi ga Al’ummai su yi masa ba’a, su yi masa bulala, su kuma gicciye shi. A rana ta uku kuma a tashe shi!”

title: Matta 20:20
content: 20 Sai mahaifiyar ’ya’yan Zebedin nan ta zo wurin Yesu tare da ’ya’yanta, da ta durƙusa a ƙasa, sai ta roƙe shi yă yi mata wani abu.

title: Matta 20:21
content: 21 Ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Mene ne kike so?” Ta ce, “Ka sa daga cikin ’ya’yan nan nawa biyu, ɗaya yă zauna a damarka, ɗaya kuma a hagunka, a mulkinka.”

title: Matta 20:22
content: 22 Yesu ya ce musu, “Ba ku san abin da kuke roƙo ba. Za ku iya sha daga kwaf da zan sha?” Suka amsa, “Za mu iya.”

title: Matta 20:23
content: 23 Yesu ya ce musu, “Tabbatacce za ku sha daga kwaf na, sai dai zama a damana, ko haguna, ba ni nake da izinin bayarwa ba. Waɗannan wurare na waɗanda Ubana ya shirya wa ne.”

title: Matta 20:24
content: 24 Da goman suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi da ’yan’uwan nan biyu.

title: Matta 20:25
content: 25 Yesu ya kira su wuri ɗaya ya ce, “Kun san cewa masu mulkin Al’ummai sukan nuna musu iko, hakimansu kuma sukan gasa musu iko.

title: Matta 20:26
content: 26 Ba haka zai kasance da ku ba. Maimakon haka, duk mai son zama babba a cikinku, dole yă zama bawanku,

title: Matta 20:27
content: 27 kuma duk mai son zama shugaba, dole yă zama bawanku,

title: Matta 20:28
content: 28 kamar yadda Ɗan Mutum bai zo don a bauta masa ba, sai dai don yă yi bauta, yă kuma ba da ransa fansa saboda mutane da yawa.”

title: Matta 20:29
content: 29 Sa’ad da Yesu da almajiransa suke barin Yeriko, sai wani babban taro ya bi shi.

title: Matta 20:30
content: 30 Makafi biyu kuwa suna zaune a bakin hanya, da suka ji cewa Yesu yana wucewa, sai suka ɗaga murya suka ce, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka ji tausayinmu!”

title: Matta 20:31
content: 31 Mutane suka tsawata musu, suka ce musu su yi shiru. Sai suka ƙara ɗaga murya suna cewa, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka ji tausayinmu!”

title: Matta 20:32
content: 32 Yesu ya tsaya ya kira su. Ya tambaye su, “Me kuke so in yi muku?”

title: Matta 20:33
content: 33 Suka amsa suka ce, “Ubangiji, muna so mu sami ganin gari.”

title: Matta 20:34
content: 34 Sai Yesu ya ji tausayinsu, ya taɓa idanunsu. Nan da nan kuwa suka sami ganin gari, suka kuma bi shi.

title: Matta 21:1
content: 1 Da suka yi kusa da Urushalima suka kuma kai Betfaji da yake kan Dutsen Zaitun, sai Yesu ya aiki almajirai biyu,

title: Matta 21:2
content: 2 yana ce musu, “Ku je ƙauyen da yake gabanku, nan take za ku ga wata jaka a daure tare da ɗanta kusa da ita, a can. Ku kunce su ku kawo mini.

title: Matta 21:3
content: 3 In wani ya yi muku wata magana, ku ce masa Ubangiji yana bukatarsu, zai kuwa mai da su nan da nan.”

title: Matta 21:4
content: 4 Wannan ya faru ne don a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabin cewa,

title: Matta 21:5
content: 5 “Ku ce wa Diyar Sihiyona, ‘Duba, sarkinki yana zuwa gare ki, mai tawali’u yana a kan jaki, a kan aholaki, ɗan jaki.’ ”

title: Matta 21:6
content: 6 Almajiran suka tafi suka yi kamar yadda Yesu ya umarce su.

title: Matta 21:7
content: 7 Suka kawo jakar da ɗanta, suka shimfiɗa mayafansu a kansu, Yesu kuma ya zauna a kansu.

title: Matta 21:8
content: 8 Wani babban taron mutane suka shimfiɗa mayafansu a kan hanya, yayinda waɗansu suka sassari rassan itatuwa suka shisshimfiɗa a kan hanya.

title: Matta 21:9
content: 9 Taron mutanen da suke gabansa da kuma waɗanda suke binsa a baya suka yi ihu suna cewa, “Hosanna ga Ɗan Dawuda!” “Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji!” “Hosanna a cikin sama!”

title: Matta 21:10
content: 10 Sa’ad da Yesu ya shiga Urushalima, dukan birnin ya ruɗe, ana ta tambaya, “Wane ne wannan?”

title: Matta 21:11
content: 11 Taron mutane suka amsa, “Wannan shi ne Yesu, annabin nan daga Nazaret a Galili.”

title: Matta 21:12
content: 12 Yesu ya shiga filin haikali, ya kuma kori duk masu saya da sayarwa a can. Ya tutture tebur masu canjin kuɗi da kuma kujerun masu sayar da tattabarai.

title: Matta 21:13
content: 13 Ya ce musu, “A rubuce yake, ‘Za a ce da gidana, gidan addu’a,’ amma kuna mai da shi ‘kogon ’yan fashi.’ ”

title: Matta 21:14
content: 14 Makafi da guragu suka zo wurinsa a haikali, ya kuwa warkar da su.

title: Matta 21:15
content: 15 Amma da manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki suka ga abubuwan banmamakin da ya yi, yara kuma suna ihu a filin haikali suna cewa, “Hosanna ga Ɗan Dawuda,” sai fushi ya kama su.

title: Matta 21:16
content: 16 Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Kana jin abin da waɗannan suke faɗa?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, ba ku taɓa karanta ba cewa, “ ‘Daga leɓunan yara da jarirai kai, Ubangiji, ka shirya wa kanka yabo’?”

title: Matta 21:17
content: 17 Sai ya bar su, ya fita daga birnin ya tafi Betani, inda ya kwana.

title: Matta 21:18
content: 18 Kashegari da sassafe, yayinda yake kan hanyarsa ta komawa cikin birni, sai ya ji yunwa.

title: Matta 21:19
content: 19 Ganin itacen ɓaure kusa da hanya, sai ya je wajensa amma bai sami kome a kansa ba sai ganye. Sai ya ce masa, “Kada ka ƙara yin ’ya’ya!” Nan da nan itacen ya yanƙwane.

title: Matta 21:20
content: 20 Sa’ad da almajiran suka ga haka, sai suka yi mamaki suna tambaya, “Yaya itacen ɓauren ya yanƙwane nan da nan haka?”

title: Matta 21:21
content: 21 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in kuna da bangaskiya, ba kuwa da wata shakka ba, ba kawai za ku iya yin abin da aka yi wa itacen ɓauren nan ba, amma za ku ma iya ce wa dutsen nan, ‘Je ka, ka jefa kanka cikin teku,’ sai yă faru.

title: Matta 21:22
content: 22 In kun gaskata, za ku karɓi duk abin da kuka roƙa a cikin addu’a.”

title: Matta 21:23
content: 23 Sai Yesu ya shiga filin haikali, yayinda yake koyarwa, sai manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane suka zo wurinsa suka yi tambaya, “Da wane iko kake yin waɗannan abubuwa? Kuma wa ya ba ka wannan iko?”

title: Matta 21:24
content: 24 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ni ma zan yi muku tambaya guda. In kuka ba ni amsa, ni ma zan gaya muku ko da wane iko nake yin waɗannan abubuwa.

title: Matta 21:25
content: 25 Baftismar Yohanna, daga ina ta fito? Daga sama ce, ko daga mutane?” Sai suka tattauna a junansu suka ce, “In muka ce, ‘Daga sama,’ zai ce, ‘To, me ya sa ba mu gaskata shi ba?’

title: Matta 21:26
content: 26 In kuma muka ce, ‘Daga mutane,’ muna tsoron mutane, gama duk sun ɗauka Yohanna annabi ne.”

title: Matta 21:27
content: 27 Saboda haka suka amsa wa Yesu suka ce, “Ba mu sani ba.” Sai ya ce, “Ni ma ba zan gaya muku ko da wane iko nake yin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”

title: Matta 21:28
content: 28 “Me kuka gani? An yi wani mutum wanda yake da ’ya’ya biyu maza. Sai ya je wajen ɗan farin ya ce, ‘Ɗana, yau tafi gonar inabi ka yi aiki.’

title: Matta 21:29
content: 29 “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘Ba zan tafi ba,’ amma daga baya ya sāke tunani, ya tafi.

title: Matta 21:30
content: 30 “Sai mahaifin ya tafi waje na biyun ya faɗa masa iri magana guda. Sai ya amsa ya ce, ‘Zan tafi, ranka yă daɗe,’ amma bai tafi ba.

title: Matta 21:31
content: 31 “Wanne cikin yaran nan biyu ya yi abin da mahaifinsa yake so?” Suka amsa, “Na farin.” Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, masu karɓar haraji da karuwai suna riga ku shiga mulkin Allah.

title: Matta 21:32
content: 32 Gama Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo wurinku don yă nuna muku hanyar adalci, ba ku gaskata shi ba, amma masu karɓar haraji da karuwai sun gaskata. Har ma bayan kun ga wannan, ba ku tuba kun gaskata shi ba.”

title: Matta 21:33
content: 33 “Ku saurari wani misali. An yi wani mai gona wanda ya yi gonar inabi. Ya kewaye ta da katanga, ya haƙa wurin matsin inabi a ciki, ya kuma gina hasumiyar gadi. Sa’an nan ya ba wa waɗansu manoma hayar gonar inabin, ya kuma yi tafiya.

title: Matta 21:34
content: 34 Da lokacin girbi ya yi kusa, sai ya aiki bayinsa wajen ’yan hayan, su karɓo masa ’ya’yan inabi.

title: Matta 21:35
content: 35 “Amma ’yan hayan suka kama bayinsa; suka dūke ɗaya, suka kashe ɗaya, suka kuma jajjefi na ukun.

title: Matta 21:36
content: 36 Sai ya sāke aiken waɗansu bayi wurinsu, fiye da na dā yawa, amma ’yan hayan suka yi musu kamar yadda suka yi wa na farin.

title: Matta 21:37
content: 37 A ƙarshe, sai ya aiki ɗansa a wurinsu. Ya ce, ‘Za su girmama ɗana.’

title: Matta 21:38
content: 38 “Amma da ’yan hayan suka hangi ɗan, sai suka ce wa juna, ‘Wannan shi ne magājin. Ku zo, mu kashe shi, mu ci gādonsa.’

title: Matta 21:39
content: 39 Saboda haka suka kama shi, suka jefar da shi bayan katangar gonar inabin, suka kashe shi.

title: Matta 21:40
content: 40 “To, idan mai gonar inabin ya zo, me zai yi da ’yan hayan nan?”

title: Matta 21:41
content: 41 Suka amsa suka ce, “Zai yi wa banzan mutanen nan mugun kisa, yă ba da hayar gonar inabin ga waɗansu ’yan haya, waɗanda za su ba shi rabonsa na amfanin gona a lokacin girbi.”

title: Matta 21:42
content: 42 Yesu ya ce musu, “Ashe, ba ku taɓa karanta a cikin Nassi cewa, “ ‘Dutsen da magina suka ƙi shi ne ya zama dutsen kusurwar gini. Ubangiji ne ya aikata wannan, kuma abin mamaki ne a idanunmu’?

title: Matta 21:43
content: 43 “Saboda haka, ina gaya muku cewa za a karɓe mulkin Allah daga gare ku, a ba wa mutanen da za su ba da amfani.

title: Matta 21:44
content: 44 Duk wanda ya fāɗi a kan dutsen nan, zai kakkarye. Amma duk wanda dutsen nan ya fāɗi a kansa, za a murƙushe shi.”

title: Matta 21:45
content: 45 Da manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa suka ji misalan Yesu, sai suka gane cewa da su yake.

title: Matta 21:46
content: 46 Suka nemi hanyar kama shi, amma suka ji tsoron taron, don mutane sun ɗauka shi annabi ne.

title: Matta 22:1
content: 1 Yesu ya sāke yin musu magana da misalai, yana cewa,

title: Matta 22:2
content: 2 “Mulkin sama yana kama da wani sarki wanda ya shirya bikin auren ɗansa.

title: Matta 22:3
content: 3 Sai ya aiki bayinsa su kira waɗanda aka gayyata zuwa bikin, amma waɗanda aka ce su zo bikin, suka ƙi zuwa.

title: Matta 22:4
content: 4 “Sai ya sāke aiken waɗansu bayi ya ce, ‘Ku ce wa waɗanda aka gayyata cewa na shirya abinci. An yanka bijimai da shanun da aka yi kiwo, kome a shirye yake. Ku zo bikin auren mana.’

title: Matta 22:5
content: 5 “Amma ba su kula ba, suka kama gabansu, ɗaya ya tafi gonarsa, ɗaya kuma ya tafi kasuwancinsa.

title: Matta 22:6
content: 6 Sauran suka kama bayinsa suka wulaƙanta su, suka kuma kashe su.

title: Matta 22:7
content: 7 Sai sarkin ya yi fushi. Ya aiki mayaƙansa suka karkashe masu kisankan nan, aka kuma ƙone birninsu.

title: Matta 22:8
content: 8 “Sa’an nan ya ce wa bayinsa, ‘Bikin aure fa ya shiryu, sai dai mutanen da na gayyata ba su dace ba.

title: Matta 22:9
content: 9 Ku bi titi-titi ku gayyato duk waɗanda kuka gani, su zo bikin.’

title: Matta 22:10
content: 10 Saboda haka bayin suka bi titi-titi, suka tattaro duk mutanen da suka samu, masu kirki da marasa kirki, zauren bikin ya cika makil da baƙi.

title: Matta 22:11
content: 11 “Amma da sarkin ya shigo don yă ga baƙin, sai ya ga wani can da ba ya sanye da kayan auren.

title: Matta 22:12
content: 12 Ya yi tambaya ya ce, ‘Aboki, yaya ka shigo nan ba tare da rigar aure ba?’ Mutumin ya rasa ta cewa.

title: Matta 22:13
content: 13 “Sai sarkin ya ce wa fadawa, ‘Ku daure shi hannu da ƙafa, ku jefar da shi waje, cikin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.’

title: Matta 22:14
content: 14 “Gama kirayayu da yawa, amma zaɓaɓɓu kaɗan ne zaɓaɓɓu.”

title: Matta 22:15
content: 15 Sai Farisiyawa suka yi waje, suka ƙulla yadda za su yi masa tarko cikin maganarsa.

title: Matta 22:16
content: 16 Suka aiki almajiransu tare da mutanen Hiridus wurinsa. Suka ce, “Malam, mun san kai mutum ne mai mutunci, kuma kana koyar da maganar Allah bisa gaskiya. Mutane ba sa ɗaukan hankalinka, domin ba ka kula ko su wane ne ba.

title: Matta 22:17
content: 17 To, ka gaya mana, a ra’ayinka? Ya dace a biya Kaisar haraji ko a’a?”

title: Matta 22:18
content: 18 Amma Yesu da yake ya san mugun nufinsu, sai ya ce, “Ku munafukai, don me kuke ƙoƙarin sa mini tarko?

title: Matta 22:19
content: 19 Ku nuna mini kuɗin da ake biyan haraji da shi.” Sai suka kawo masa dinari,

title: Matta 22:20
content: 20 sai ya tambaye su ya ce, “Hoton wane ne wannan? Kuma rubutun wane ne?”

title: Matta 22:21
content: 21 Suka amsa, “Na Kaisar ne.” Sai ya ce musu, “Ku ba wa Kaisar abin da yake na Kaisar, ku kuma ba wa Allah abin da yake na Allah.”

title: Matta 22:22
content: 22 Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi mamaki. Saboda haka suka ƙyale shi, suka yi tafiyarsu.

title: Matta 22:23
content: 23 A ranan nan Sadukiyawa, waɗanda suke cewa babu tashin matattu, suka zo wurinsa da tambaya.

title: Matta 22:24
content: 24 Suka ce “Malam, Musa ya faɗa mana cewa in mutum ya mutu ba shi da ’ya’ya, dole ɗan’uwansa yă auri gwauruwar yă kuma haifar wa ɗan’uwan ’ya’ya.

title: Matta 22:25
content: 25 A cikinmu an yi ’yan’uwa guda bakwai. Na fari ya yi aure, ya mutu, da yake bai sami ’ya’ya ba, sai ya bar matarsa wa ɗan’uwansa.

title: Matta 22:26
content: 26 Haka ya faru da ɗan’uwa na biyu da na uku, har zuwa na bakwai.

title: Matta 22:27
content: 27 A ƙarshe, macen ta mutu.

title: Matta 22:28
content: 28 To, a tashin matattu, matar wa a cikinsu bakwai ɗin nan za tă zama, da yake dukansu sun aure ta?”

title: Matta 22:29
content: 29 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Kun ɓata, domin ba ku san Nassi ko ikon Allah ba.

title: Matta 22:30
content: 30 Ai, a tashin matattu, mutane ba za su yi aure ko su ba da aure ba; za su zama kamar mala’iku a sama.

title: Matta 22:31
content: 31 Amma game da tashi daga matattu na waɗanda suka mutu ba ku karanta abin da Allah ya ce muku ba ne,

title: Matta 22:32
content: 32 ‘Ni ne Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku da kuma Allah na Yaƙub’? Ai, shi ba Allah na matattu ba ne, shi Allah na masu rai ne.”

title: Matta 22:33
content: 33 Da taro suka ji haka, sai suka yi mamakin koyarwarsa.

title: Matta 22:34
content: 34 Da jin Yesu ya ƙure Sadukiyawa, sai Farisiyawa suka tattaru.

title: Matta 22:35
content: 35 Ɗaya daga cikinsu, wani masanin Doka, ya gwada shi da wannan tambaya.

title: Matta 22:36
content: 36 “Malam, wace doka ce mafi girma a cikin dokoki?”

title: Matta 22:37
content: 37 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “ ‘Ka ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnka da dukan zuciyarka da dukan ranka da kuma dukan hankalinka.’

title: Matta 22:38
content: 38 Wannan, ita ce doka ta fari da kuma mafi girma.

title: Matta 22:39
content: 39 Ta biye kuma kamar ta farkon take. ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’

title: Matta 22:40
content: 40 Dukan Doka da Annabawa suna rataya ne a kan waɗannan dokoki biyu.”

title: Matta 22:41
content: 41 Yayinda Farisiyawa suke a tattare wuri ɗaya, sai Yesu ya tambaye su,

title: Matta 22:42
content: 42 “Me kuke tsammani game da Kiristi? Ɗan wane ne shi?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Ɗan Dawuda.”

title: Matta 22:43
content: 43 Ya ce musu, “To, ta yaya Dawuda ya yi magana ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji’? Gama ya ce,

title: Matta 22:44
content: 44 “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana, sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.” ’

title: Matta 22:45
content: 45 To, in Dawuda ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji,’ yaya zai zama ɗansa?”

title: Matta 22:46
content: 46 Ba wanda ya iya tanka masa, daga wannan rana kuwa ba wanda ya sāke yin karambanin yin masa wata tambaya.

title: Matta 23:1
content: 1 Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa taron mutane da kuma almajiransa,

title: Matta 23:2
content: 2 “Malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa suke zama a kujerar Musa.

title: Matta 23:3
content: 3 Saboda haka dole ku yi musu biyayya, ku kuma yi duk abin da suka faɗa muku. Sai dai kada ku yi abin da suke yi, gama ba sa yin abin da suke wa’azi.

title: Matta 23:4
content: 4 Sukan ɗaura kaya masu nauyi, su sa wa mutane a kafaɗa. Amma su kansu, ba sa ko sa yatsa su taimaka.

title: Matta 23:5
content: 5 “Kome suke yi, suna yi ne don mutane su gani. Sukan yi layunsu fantam-fantam bakin rigunarsu kuma sukan kai har ƙasa;

title: Matta 23:6
content: 6 suna son wurin zaman manya a wurin biki, da kuma wuraren zama gaba-gaba a majami’u;

title: Matta 23:7
content: 7 suna so a yi ta gaisuwarsu a kasuwa, ana kuma riƙa ce musu, ‘Rabbi.’

title: Matta 23:8
content: 8 “Amma kada a kira ku ‘Rabbi,’ gama kuna da Maigida ɗaya ne, ku duka kuwa, ’yan’uwa ne.

title: Matta 23:9
content: 9 Kada kuma ku kira wani a duniya ‘uba,’ gama kuna da Uba ɗaya ne, yana kuwa a sama.

title: Matta 23:10
content: 10 Ba kuwa za a kira ku ‘malam’ ba, gama kuna da Malami ɗaya ne, Kiristi.

title: Matta 23:11
content: 11 Mafi girma a cikinku, zai zama bawanku.

title: Matta 23:12
content: 12 Gama duk wanda ya ɗaukaka kansa, za a ƙasƙantar da shi, duk kuma wanda ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, za a ɗaukaka shi.

title: Matta 23:13
content: 13 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, ku munafukai! Kun rufe ƙofar mulkin sama a gaban mutane. Ku kanku ba ku shiga ba, ba kuwa bar waɗanda suke ƙoƙarin shiga su shiga ba.

title: Matta 23:15
content: 15 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan yi tafiye-tafiye zuwa ƙasashe, ku ƙetare teku don ku sami mai tuba ɗaya, sa’ad da ya tuba kuwa, sai ku mai da shi ɗan wuta fiye da ku, har sau biyu.

title: Matta 23:16
content: 16 “Kaitonku, makafi jagora! Kukan ce, ‘In wani ya rantse da haikali, ba damuwa; amma in ya rantse da zinariyar haikali, sai rantsuwar ta kama shi.’

title: Matta 23:17
content: 17 Wawaye makafi! Wanne ya fi girma, zinariyar, ko haikalin da yake tsarkake zinariyar?

title: Matta 23:18
content: 18 Kukan kuma ce, ‘In wani ya rantse da bagade, ba damuwa; amma in ya rantse da bayarwar da take bisansa, sai rantsuwar ta kama shi.’

title: Matta 23:19
content: 19 Makafi kawai! Wanne ya fi girma, bayarwar, ko kuwa bagaden da yake tsarkake bayarwar?

title: Matta 23:20
content: 20 Saboda haka, duk wanda ya rantse da bagade, ya rantse ne da bagaden tare da abin da yake bisansa.

title: Matta 23:21
content: 21 Kuma duk wanda ya rantse da haikali, ya rantse ne da shi da kuma wanda yake zaune a cikinsa.

title: Matta 23:22
content: 22 Duk kuma wanda ya rantse da sama, ya rantse ne da kursiyin Allah da kuma wanda yake zaune a kansa.

title: Matta 23:23
content: 23 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan ba da kashi ɗaya bisa goma na kayan yajinku, na’ana’a, anise, da lafsur. Amma kun ƙyale abubuwan da suka fi girma na dokoki, adalci, jinƙai da aminci. Waɗannan ne ya kamata da kun kiyaye ba tare da kun ƙyale sauran ba.

title: Matta 23:24
content: 24 Makafi jagora! Kukan tace ƙwaro ɗan mitsil amma sai ku haɗiye raƙumi.

title: Matta 23:25
content: 25 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan wanke bayan kwaf da kwano, amma a ciki, cike suke da zalunci da sonkai.

title: Matta 23:26
content: 26 Kai makaho Bafarisiye! Ka fara wanke cikin kwaf da kwano, sa’an nan bayan ma zai zama da tsabta.

title: Matta 23:27
content: 27 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kuna kama da kaburburan da aka shafa musu farin fenti, waɗanda suna da kyan gani a waje, amma a ciki, cike suke da ƙasusuwan matattu da kuma kowane irin abu mai ƙazanta.

title: Matta 23:28
content: 28 Haka ku ma, a waje, a idon mutane, ku masu adalci ne, amma a ciki, cike kuke da munafunci da mugunta.

title: Matta 23:29
content: 29 “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan gina kaburbura don annabawa, ku kuma yi wa kaburburan mutane masu adalci ado.

title: Matta 23:30
content: 30 Kuna cewa, ‘Da mun kasance a zamanin kakanninmu, ai, da ba mu haɗa hannu da su muka karkashe annabawa ba.’

title: Matta 23:31
content: 31 Ta haka kuna ba da shaida a kanku cewa ku zuriyar waɗanda suka karkashe annabawa ne.

title: Matta 23:32
content: 32 To, sai ku ci gaba ku cikasa ayyukan da kakanninku suka fara!

title: Matta 23:33
content: 33 “Ku macizai! ’Ya’yan macizai! Ta yaya za ku tsere wa hukuncin jahannama ta wuta?

title: Matta 23:34
content: 34 Saboda haka ina aika muku da annabawa, da masu hikima da malamai. Waɗansunsu za ku kashe ku kuma gicciye; waɗansu kuma za ku yi musu bulala a majami’unku kuna kuma binsu gari-gari.

title: Matta 23:35
content: 35 Ta haka alhakin jinin masu adalcin da aka zubar a duniya, tun daga jinin Habila mai adalci, zuwa jinin Zakariya ɗan Berekiya, wanda kuka kashe tsakanin haikali da bagade zai koma kanku.

title: Matta 23:36
content: 36 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wannan zai auko wa wannan zamani.

title: Matta 23:37
content: 37 “Urushalima, ayya Urushalima, ke da kike kashe annabawa, kike kuma jifan waɗanda aka aiko gare ki, sau da sau na so in tattara ’ya’yanki wuri ɗaya, yadda kaza takan tattara ’ya’yanta cikin fikafikanta, amma kuka ƙi.

title: Matta 23:38
content: 38 Ga shi, an bar muku gidanku a yashe.

title: Matta 23:39
content: 39 Gama ina gaya muku, ba za ku sāke ganina ba sai kun ce, ‘Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji.’ ”

title: Matta 24:1
content: 1 Yesu ya bar haikali ke nan, yana cikin tafiya sai almajiransa suka zo wurinsa don su ja hankalinsa ga gine-ginen haikali.

title: Matta 24:2
content: 2 Sai Yesu ya ce, “Kun ga duk waɗannan abubuwa? Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba wani dutse a nan da za a bari a kan wani; duk za a rushe.”

title: Matta 24:3
content: 3 Da Yesu yana zaune a Dutsen Zaitun, almajiran suka zo wurinsa a ɓoye. Suka ce, “Gaya mana, yaushe ne wannan zai faru, mece ce alamar zuwanka da kuma ta ƙarshen zamani?”

title: Matta 24:4
content: 4 Yesu ya amsa, “Ku lura fa, kada wani yă ruɗe ku.

title: Matta 24:5
content: 5 Gama mutane da yawa za su zo cikin sunana, suna cewa, ‘Ni ne Kiristi,’ za su kuwa ruɗi mutane da yawa.

title: Matta 24:6
content: 6 Za ku ji labarin yaƙe-yaƙe da kuma jita-jitarsu, sai dai ku lura kada hankalinku yă tashi. Dole irin waɗannan abubuwa su faru, amma ƙarshen tukuna.

title: Matta 24:7
content: 7 Al’umma za tă tasar wa al’umma, mulki yă tasar wa mulki. Za a yi yunwa da girgizar ƙasa a wurare dabam-dabam.

title: Matta 24:8
content: 8 Dukan waɗannan fa, mafarin azabar naƙudar haihuwa ne.

title: Matta 24:9
content: 9 “Sa’an nan za a bashe ku don a tsananta muku a kuma kashe ku, dukan al’ummai za su ƙi ku saboda ni.

title: Matta 24:10
content: 10 A wannan lokaci, da yawa za su juya daga bangaskiya, su ci amana su kuma ƙi juna,

title: Matta 24:11
content: 11 annabawan ƙarya da yawa za su firfito su kuma ruɗi mutane da yawa.

title: Matta 24:12
content: 12 Saboda ƙaruwar mugunta, ƙaunar yawanci za tă yi sanyi,

title: Matta 24:13
content: 13 amma duk wanda ya tsaya da ƙarfi har ƙarshe, zai sami ceto.

title: Matta 24:14
content: 14 Za a kuma yi wa’azin wannan bisharar mulki a cikin dukan duniya, yă zama shaida ga dukan al’ummai, sa’an nan ƙarshen yă zo.

title: Matta 24:15
content: 15 “Saboda haka sa’ad da kuka ga ‘abin ƙyama mai kawo hallaka,’ wanda annabi Daniyel ya yi magana a kai, yana tsaye a tsattsarkan wuri (mai karatu yă gane),

title: Matta 24:16
content: 16 to, sai waɗanda suke cikin Yahudiya, su gudu zuwa cikin duwatsu.

title: Matta 24:17
content: 17 Kada wani da yake a kan rufin gidansa, yă sauko don ɗaukar wani abu a gida.

title: Matta 24:18
content: 18 Kada wani da yake gona kuma yă komo don ɗaukar rigarsa.

title: Matta 24:19
content: 19 Kaiton mata masu ciki da mata masu renon ’ya’ya a waɗancan kwanakin!

title: Matta 24:20
content: 20 Ku yi addu’a, kada gudunku yă zama a lokacin sanyi ko a ranar Asabbaci.

title: Matta 24:21
content: 21 Gama a lokacin za a yi wata matsananciyar wahala, wadda ba a taɓa yi ba tun farkon duniya har ya zuwa yanzu ba kuwa za a ƙara yi ba.

title: Matta 24:22
content: 22 “Da ba don an taƙaita kwanakin nan ba, da babu wani da zai tsira, amma saboda zaɓaɓɓun nan, za a taƙaita kwanakin.

title: Matta 24:23
content: 23 A lokacin in wani ya ce muku, ‘Duba, ga Kiristi nan!’ Ko, ‘Ga shi can!’ Kada ku gaskata.

title: Matta 24:24
content: 24 Gama Kiristi masu yawa na ƙarya, da annabawan ƙarya za su firfito, su kuma aikata manyan alamu da ayyukan banmamaki don su ruɗi har da zaɓaɓɓu ma in zai yiwu.

title: Matta 24:25
content: 25 Ga shi, na faɗa muku tun da wuri.

title: Matta 24:26
content: 26 “Saboda haka in wani ya ce muku, ‘Ga shi can a hamada,’ kada ku fita; ko, ‘Ga shi nan a ɗakunan ciki,’ kada ku gaskata.

title: Matta 24:27
content: 27 Gama kamar yadda walƙiya take wulgawa walai daga gabas zuwa yamma, haka dawowar Ɗan Mutum zai kasance.

title: Matta 24:28
content: 28 Duk inda mushe yake, can ungulai za su taru.

title: Matta 24:29
content: 29 “Nan da nan bayan tsabar wahalan nan “ ‘sai a duhunta rana, wata kuma ba zai ba da haskensa ba; taurari kuma za su fāffāɗi daga sararin sama, za a kuma girgiza abubuwan sararin sama.’

title: Matta 24:30
content: 30 “A sa’an nan ne alamar dawowar Ɗan Mutum zai bayyana a sararin sama, dukan al’umman duniya kuwa za su yi kuka. Za su ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa kan gizagizan sararin sama, da iko da kuma ɗaukaka mai girma.

title: Matta 24:31
content: 31 Zai kuwa aiki mala’ikunsa su busa ƙaho mai ƙara sosai, za su kuwa tattaro zaɓaɓɓunsa daga kusurwoyi huɗun nan, daga wannan bangon duniya zuwa wancan.

title: Matta 24:32
content: 32 “Yanzu fa, sai ku koyi wannan darasi daga itacen ɓaure. Da zarar rassansa suka yi taushi ganyayensa kuma suka toho, kun san damina ta kusa.

title: Matta 24:33
content: 33 Haka kuma, sa’ad da kun ga dukan waɗannan abubuwa, ku sani ya yi kusan zuwa, yana ma dab da bakin ƙofa.

title: Matta 24:34
content: 34 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, wannan zamani ba zai shuɗe ba sai dukan abubuwan nan sun faru.

title: Matta 24:35
content: 35 Sama da ƙasa za su shuɗe, amma maganata ba za tă taɓa shuɗe ba.

title: Matta 24:36
content: 36 “Babu wanda ya san wannan rana ko sa’a, ko mala’ikun da suke sama ma, ko Ɗan, sai dai Uban kaɗai.

title: Matta 24:37
content: 37 Kamar yadda ya faru a zamanin Nuhu, haka zai zama a dawowar Ɗan Mutum.

title: Matta 24:38
content: 38 Gama a kwanaki kafin ruwan tsufana, mutane sun yi ta ci, sun kuma yi ta sha, suna aure, suna kuma aurarwa, har zuwa ranar da Nuhu ya shiga jirgi;

title: Matta 24:39
content: 39 ba su kuwa san abin da yake faruwa ba sai da ruwan tsufana ya zo ya share su tas. Haka zai zama a dawowar Ɗan Mutum.

title: Matta 24:40
content: 40 Maza biyu za su kasance a gona; za a ɗau ɗaya a bar ɗaya.

title: Matta 24:41
content: 41 Mata biyu za su kasance suna niƙa; za a ɗau ɗaya a bar ɗaya.

title: Matta 24:42
content: 42 “Saboda haka sai ku zauna a faɗake, gama ba ku san a wace rana ce Ubangijinku zai zo ba.

title: Matta 24:43
content: 43 Ku dai gane wannan, da maigida ya san ko a wane lokaci ne da dare, ɓarawo zai zo, da sai yă zauna a faɗake yă kuma hana a shiga masa gida.

title: Matta 24:44
content: 44 Saboda haka ku ma, sai ku zauna a faɗake, domin Ɗan Mutum zai zo a sa’ar da ba ku za tă ba.

title: Matta 24:45
content: 45 “Wane ne bawan nan mai aminci da kuma mai hikima, wanda maigida ya sa yă lura da bayi a cikin gidansa, yă riƙa ba su abinci a daidai lokaci?

title: Matta 24:46
content: 46 Zai zama wa bawan nan da kyau in maigidan ya dawo ya same shi yana yin haka.

title: Matta 24:47
content: 47 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, zai sa shi yă lura da dukan dukiyarsa.

title: Matta 24:48
content: 48 Amma in wannan bawa mugu ne, ya kuma ce a ransa, ‘Maigidana ba zai dawo da wuri ba.’

title: Matta 24:49
content: 49 Sa’an nan yă fara dūkan ’yan’uwansa bayi, yana ci yana kuma sha tare da mashaya.

title: Matta 24:50
content: 50 Maigidan wannan bawa zai dawo a ranar da bai yi tsammani ba, a sa’ar kuma da bai sani ba.

title: Matta 24:51
content: 51 Maigidan zai farfasa masa jiki da bulala, yă kuma ba shi wuri tare da munafukai, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.

title: Matta 25:1
content: 1 “A lokacin mulkin sama zai zama kamar budurwai goma waɗanda suka ɗauki fitilunsu suka fita don su taryi ango.

title: Matta 25:2
content: 2 Biyar daga cikinsu wawaye ne, biyar kuma masu hikima.

title: Matta 25:3
content: 3 Wawayen sun ɗauki fitilunsu, sai dai ba su riƙe mai ba.

title: Matta 25:4
content: 4 Masu hikimar kuwa suka riƙo tulunan mai da fitilunsu.

title: Matta 25:5
content: 5 Ango ya yi jinkirin zuwa, sai duk suka shiga gyangyaɗi har barci ya kwashe su.

title: Matta 25:6
content: 6 “Can tsakar dare, sai aka ji kira, ana cewa, ‘Ga ango nan! Ku fito, ku tarye shi!’

title: Matta 25:7
content: 7 “Sai dukan budurwan nan suka farka suka kuna fitilunsu.

title: Matta 25:8
content: 8 Sai wawayen suka ce wa masu hikimar, ‘Ku ɗan sassam mana manku; fitilunmu suna mutuwa.’

title: Matta 25:9
content: 9 “Su kuwa suka amsa, suka ce, ‘A’a, wataƙila ba zai ishe mu da ku ba. Gara ku je wurin masu sayarwa ku sayo.’

title: Matta 25:10
content: 10 “Amma yayinda suke kan tafiya garin sayen mai, sai ango ya iso. Budurwai da suke a shirye, suka shiga wajen bikin auren tare da shi. Aka kuma kulle ƙofa.

title: Matta 25:11
content: 11 “An jima can, sai ga sauran sun iso. Suka ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe! Ranka yă daɗe! Ka buɗe mana ƙofa!’

title: Matta 25:12
content: 12 “Amma ya amsa ya ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ban san ku ba.’

title: Matta 25:13
content: 13 “Saboda haka sai ku zauna a faɗake, don ba ku san ranar ko sa’ar ba.

title: Matta 25:14
content: 14 “Har wa yau, za a kwatanta shi da mutumin da zai yi tafiya, wanda ya kira bayinsa ya kuma danƙa musu mallakarsa.

title: Matta 25:15
content: 15 Ga guda, ya ba shi talenti biyar na kuɗi, ga wani talenti biyu, ga wani kuma talenti ɗaya, kowa bisa ga azancinsa. Sa’an nan ya yi tafiyarsa.

title: Matta 25:16
content: 16 Mutumin da ya karɓi talenti biyar, nan da nan ya tafi ya yi kasuwanci da su har ya sami ribar talenti biyar.

title: Matta 25:17
content: 17 Haka ma, wannan mai talenti biyu, shi ma ya yi riba biyu.

title: Matta 25:18
content: 18 Amma mutumin da ya karɓi talenti ɗaya ɗin, ya tafi, ya tona rami, ya ɓoye kuɗin maigidansa.

title: Matta 25:19
content: 19 “Bayan an daɗe, sai maigidan bayin nan ya dawo, ya kuma daidaita lissafi da su.

title: Matta 25:20
content: 20 Mutumin da ya karɓi talenti biyar, ya kawo ƙarin talenti biyar. Ya ce, ‘Maigida, ka danƙa mini talenti biyar. Ga shi, na yi ribar biyar.’

title: Matta 25:21
content: 21 “Maigidansa ya amsa ya ce, ‘Madalla, bawan kirki mai aminci! Ka yi aminci a kan abubuwa kaɗan, zan sa ka lura da abubuwa masu yawa. Zo ka yi farin ciki tare da maigidanka!’

title: Matta 25:22
content: 22 “Mutumin da yake da talenti biyu, shi ma ya zo ya ce, ‘Maigida, ka danƙa mini talenti biyu; ga shi, na yi ribar biyu.’

title: Matta 25:23
content: 23 “Maigidansa ya amsa ya ce, ‘Madalla, bawan kirki mai aminci! Ka yi aminci a kan abubuwa kaɗan, zan sa ka lura da abubuwa masu yawa. Zo ka yi farin ciki tare da maigidanka!’

title: Matta 25:24
content: 24 “Sa’an nan mutumin da ya karɓi talenti ɗaya ya zo. Ya ce, ‘Maigida, na san cewa kai mutum ne mai wuyan sha’ani, kana girbi inda ba ka shuka ba, kana kuma tara inda ba ka yafa iri ba.

title: Matta 25:25
content: 25 Saboda haka na ji tsoro, na je na ɓoye talentinka a ƙasa. Ga abinka.’

title: Matta 25:26
content: 26 “Maigidansa ya amsa ya ce, ‘Kai mugun bawa, mai ƙyuya! Ashe, ka san cewa ina girbi inda ban yi shuka ba, ina kuma tarawa inda ban yafa iri ba?

title: Matta 25:27
content: 27 To, in haka ne, ai, da ka sa kuɗina a banki, don sa’ad da na dawo da na karɓi abina da riba.

title: Matta 25:28
content: 28 “ ‘Karɓi talentin daga hannunsa ku ba wanda yake da talenti goma.

title: Matta 25:29
content: 29 Gama duk mai abu za a ƙara masa, zai kuma same shi a yawalce. Duk wanda ba shi da shi kuwa, ko ɗan abin da yake da shi ma, sai an karɓe masa.

title: Matta 25:30
content: 30 Ku jefar da banzan bawan nan waje, cikin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.’

title: Matta 25:31
content: 31 “Sa’ad da Ɗan Mutum ya zo cikin ɗaukakarsa, tare da dukan mala’iku, zai zauna a kursiyinsa cikin ɗaukakar sama.

title: Matta 25:32
content: 32 Za a tara dukan al’ummai a gabansa, zai kuma raba mutane dabam-dabam yadda makiyayi yakan ware tumaki daga awaki.

title: Matta 25:33
content: 33 Zai sa tumaki a damansa, awaki kuma a hagunsa.

title: Matta 25:34
content: 34 “Sa’an nan Sarki zai ce wa waɗanda suke damansa, ‘Ku zo, ku da Ubana ya yi wa albarka; ku karɓi gādonku, mulkin da aka shirya muku tun halittar duniya.

title: Matta 25:35
content: 35 Gama da nake jin yunwa, kun ciyar da ni, da nake jin ƙishirwa, kun ba ni abin sha, da nake baƙunci, kun karɓe ni,

title: Matta 25:36
content: 36 da nake bukatar tufafi, kun yi mini sutura, da na yi rashin lafiya, kun lura da ni, da nake kurkuku, kun ziyarce ni.’

title: Matta 25:37
content: 37 “Sa’an nan masu adalci za su amsa masa, su ce, ‘Ubangiji, yaushe muka gan ka da yunwa muka ciyar da kai, ko da ƙishirwa muka ba ka abin sha?

title: Matta 25:38
content: 38 Yaushe kuma muka gan ka baƙo muka karɓe ka, ko cikin bukatar tufafi muka yi maka sutura?

title: Matta 25:39
content: 39 Yaushe kuma muka gan ka cikin rashin lafiya ko a kurkuku muka ziyarce ka?’

title: Matta 25:40
content: 40 “Sarkin zai amsa ya ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da kuka yi wa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ’yan’uwana mafi ƙanƙanta, ni kuka yi wa.’

title: Matta 25:41
content: 41 “Sa’an nan zai ce wa waɗanda suke a hagunsa, ‘Ku rabu da ni, la’anannu, zuwa cikin madawwamiyar wutar da aka shirya don Iblis da mala’ikunsa.

title: Matta 25:42
content: 42 Gama da nake jin yunwa, ba ku ba ni abinci ba, da nake jin ƙishirwa, ba ku ba ni abin sha ba,

title: Matta 25:43
content: 43 da na yi baƙunci, ba ku karɓe ni ba, da nake bukatar tufafi, ba ku yi mini sutura ba, da na yi rashin lafiya kuma ina a kurkuku, ba ku lura da ni ba.’

title: Matta 25:44
content: 44 “Su ma za su amsa, su ce, ‘Ubangiji, yaushe muka gan ka cikin yunwa ko ƙishirwa ko baƙo ko cikin bukatar tufafi ko cikin rashin lafiya ko cikin kurkuku, ba mu taimake ka ba?’

title: Matta 25:45
content: 45 “Zai amsa, yă ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da ba ku yi wa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan mafi ƙanƙanta ba, ba ku yi mini ba ke nan.’

title: Matta 25:46
content: 46 “Sa’an nan za su tafi cikin madawwamiyar hukunci, amma masu adalci kuwa za su shiga rai madawwami.”

title: Matta 26:1
content: 1 Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama faɗin dukan waɗannan abubuwa, sai ya ce wa almajiransa,

title: Matta 26:2
content: 2 “Kamar yadda kuka sani, Bikin Ƙetarewa sauran kwana biyu, za a kuma ba da Ɗan Mutum don a gicciye shi.”

title: Matta 26:3
content: 3 Sai manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane, suka taru a fadan babban firist, mai suna Kayifas,

title: Matta 26:4
content: 4 suka ƙulla shawara su kama Yesu da makirci, su kuma kashe shi.

title: Matta 26:5
content: 5 Suka ce, “Amma ba a lokacin Biki ba, don kada mutane su tā da rikici.”

title: Matta 26:6
content: 6 Yayinda Yesu yake a Betani, a gidan wani mutumin da ake kira Siman Kuturu,

title: Matta 26:7
content: 7 wata mace ta zo wurinsa da wani ɗan tulun alabasta na turaren mai tsada sosai, wanda ta zuba a kansa a lokacin da yake cin abinci.

title: Matta 26:8
content: 8 Sa’ad da almajiransa suka ga wannan, sai suka yi fushi. Suka ce, “Wannan almubazzaranci fa!

title: Matta 26:9
content: 9 Wannan turare ai, da an sayar da shi da kuɗi mai yawa a ba matalauta kuɗin.”

title: Matta 26:10
content: 10 Sane da wannan, Yesu ya ce musu, “Me ya sa kuke damun macen nan? Ta yi mini abu mai kyau ne.

title: Matta 26:11
content: 11 Matalauta za su kasance tare da ku kullum, amma ni ba zan kasance tare da ku kullum ba.

title: Matta 26:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da ta zuba turaren nan a jikina, ta shirya ni ne don jana’izata.

title: Matta 26:13
content: 13 Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk inda aka yi wa’azin bisharan nan a duniya duka, abin da matan nan ta yi, za a riƙa faɗarsa don tunawa da ita.”

title: Matta 26:14
content: 14 Sai ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun nan, wanda ake kira Yahuda Iskariyot, ya je wurin manyan firistoci

title: Matta 26:15
content: 15 ya ce, “Me za ku ba ni, in na bashe shi gare ku?” Sai suka ƙirga masa kuɗi azurfa talatin.

title: Matta 26:16
content: 16 Daga wannan lokaci, Yahuda ya yi ta neman zarafin da zai miƙa shi.

title: Matta 26:17
content: 17 A rana ta fari ta Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, sai almajiran suka zo wurin Yesu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Ina kake so mu je mu shirya maka wurin da za ka ci Bikin Ƙetarewa?”

title: Matta 26:18
content: 18 Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku shiga gari wurin wāne, ku ce masa, ‘Malam ya ce, lokacina ya yi kusa. Zan ci Bikin Ƙetarewa tare da almajiraina a gidanka.’ ”

title: Matta 26:19
content: 19 Saboda haka almajiran suka yi yadda Yesu ya umarce su, suka kuwa shirya Bikin Ƙetarewa.

title: Matta 26:20
content: 20 Da yamma ta yi, sai Yesu ya zauna don cin abinci tare da Sha Biyun.

title: Matta 26:21
content: 21 Yayinda suke cin abinci, sai ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗayanku zai bashe ni.”

title: Matta 26:22
content: 22 Suka yi baƙin ciki ƙwarai, suka fara ce masa da ɗaya-ɗaya, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗayanku zai bashe ni.”

title: Matta 26:23
content: 23 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wanda ya sa hannunsa a kwano tare da ni ne, zai bashe ni.

title: Matta 26:24
content: 24 Ɗan Mutum zai tafi kamar yadda aka rubuta game da shi. Amma kaiton mutumin da zai bashe Ɗan Mutum! Da ma ba a haifi mutumin nan ba, da ya fi masa.”

title: Matta 26:25
content: 25 Sa’an nan Yahuda, wanda zai bashe shi ya ce, “Tabbatacce ba ni ba ne, ko, Rabbi?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, kai ma ka fada.”

title: Matta 26:26
content: 26 Yayinda suke cikin cin abinci, Yesu ya ɗauki burodi, ya yi godiya ya kuma kakkarya, ya ba wa almajiransa yana cewa, “Ku karɓa ku ci; wannan jikina ne.”

title: Matta 26:27
content: 27 Sa’an nan ya ɗauki kwaf, ya yi godiya, ya kuma ba su, yana cewa, “Ku shassha daga cikinsa, dukanku.

title: Matta 26:28
content: 28 Wannan jinina ne na sabon alkawari, wanda aka zubar saboda mutane da yawa, don gafarar zunubai.

title: Matta 26:29
content: 29 Ina gaya muku, ba zan ƙara shan ruwan inabin nan ba har sai ranar da zan sha shi sabo tare da ku a mulkin Ubana.”

title: Matta 26:30
content: 30 Da suka rera waƙa, sai suka fita, suka tafi Dutsen Zaitun.

title: Matta 26:31
content: 31 Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “A wannan dare, dukanku za ku ja da baya saboda ni, gama a rubuce yake cewa, “ ‘Zan bugi makiyayin, tumakin garken kuwa za su fasu.’

title: Matta 26:32
content: 32 Amma bayan na tashi, zan sha gabanku zuwa Galili.”

title: Matta 26:33
content: 33 Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Ko da duka sun ja da baya saboda kai, ba zan taɓa ja da baya ba.”

title: Matta 26:34
content: 34 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya maka, a daren nan, kafin zakara yă yi cara, za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.”

title: Matta 26:35
content: 35 Bitrus ya furta, “Ko da ma zan mutu ne tare da kai, ba zan taɓa yin mūsun saninka ba.” Dukan sauran almajiran ma suka faɗa haka.

title: Matta 26:36
content: 36 Sa’an nan Yesu ya tafi da almajiransa zuwa wani wurin da ake kira Getsemane, ya ce musu, “Ku zauna nan, in je can in yi addu’a.”

title: Matta 26:37
content: 37 Ya ɗauki Bitrus da ’ya’ya biyun nan na Zebedi tare da shi, sai ya fara baƙin ciki, ya kuma damu.

title: Matta 26:38
content: 38 Sai ya ce musu, “Raina yana cike da baƙin ciki har kamar zan mutu. Ku dakata a nan, ku kuma yi tsaro tare da ni.”

title: Matta 26:39
content: 39 Da ya yi gaba kaɗan, sai ya fāɗi a ƙasa, ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubana, in mai yiwuwa ne, a ɗauke mini wannan kwaf. Amma ba nufina ba, sai naka.”

title: Matta 26:40
content: 40 Sa’an nan ya komo wurin almajiransa, ya tarar suna barci. Ya tambayi Bitrus ya ce, “Ashe, ba za ku iya yin tsaro tare da ni ko na sa’a guda ba?

title: Matta 26:41
content: 41 Ku yi tsaro, ku kuma yi addu’a, don kada ku fāɗi cikin jarraba. Ruhu yana so, sai dai jiki raunana ne.”

title: Matta 26:42
content: 42 Ya sāke tafiya sau na biyu, ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubana, in ba zai yiwu a ɗauke wannan kwaf ba sai na sha shi, to, bari a aikata nufinka.”

title: Matta 26:43
content: 43 Da ya dawo, har yanzu ya tarar suna barci, domin idanunsu sun yi nauyi da barci.

title: Matta 26:44
content: 44 Saboda haka ya sāke barinsu, ya yi addu’a sau na uku, yana maimaita iri abu guda.

title: Matta 26:45
content: 45 Sa’an nan ya komo wurin almajiransa, ya ce musu, “Har yanzu kuna barci kuna hutawa ba? Ga shi, sa’a ta yi kusa, an kuma bashe Ɗan Mutum a hannuwan masu zunubi.

title: Matta 26:46
content: 46 Ku tashi, mu tafi! Ga mai bashe ni nan yana zuwa!”

title: Matta 26:47
content: 47 Yayinda yana cikin magana, sai Yahuda, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun nan, ya iso. Tare da shi kuwa ga taro mai yawa riƙe da takuba da sanduna, manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane ne suka turo su.

title: Matta 26:48
content: 48 To, mai bashe shi ɗin, ya riga ya shirya alama da su, “Wanda na yi masa sumba, shi ne mutumin; ku kama shi.”

title: Matta 26:49
content: 49 Da zuwansa, sai ya miƙe zuwa wurin Yesu ya ce, “Gaisuwa, Rabbi!” Sa’an nan ya yi masa sumba.

title: Matta 26:50
content: 50 Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Aboki, yi abin da ya kawo ka.” Sa’an nan mutanen suka matso, suka kama Yesu suka riƙe shi.

title: Matta 26:51
content: 51 Ganin haka, sai ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suke tare da Yesu, ya zaro takobinsa ya kai wa bawan babban firist sara, ya fille masa kunne.

title: Matta 26:52
content: 52 Sai Yesu ya ce, masa, “Mai da takobinka kube, gama duk masu zare takobi, a takobi za su mutu.

title: Matta 26:53
content: 53 Kuna tsammani ba zan iya kira Ubana, nan take kuwa yă aiko mini fiye da rundunar mala’iku goma sha biyu ba?

title: Matta 26:54
content: 54 Amma ta yaya za a cika Nassin da ya ce dole haka yă faru?”

title: Matta 26:55
content: 55 A wannan lokaci sai Yesu ya ce wa taron, “Ina jagoran wani tawaye ne, da kuka fito da takuba da kuma sanduna domin ku kama ni? Kowace rana ina zama a filin haikali ina koyarwa, ba ku kuwa kama ni ba.

title: Matta 26:56
content: 56 Amma wannan duka ya faru ne don a cika rubuce-rubucen annabawa.” Sa’an nan dukan almajiran suka yashe shi suka gudu.

title: Matta 26:57
content: 57 Waɗanda suka kama Yesu kuwa suka kai shi wurin Kayifas, babban firist, inda malaman dokoki da dattawa suka taru.

title: Matta 26:58
content: 58 Amma Bitrus ya bi daga nesa, har zuwa cikin filin gidan babban firist. Ya shiga, ya zauna tare da masu gadi, don yă ga ƙarshen abin.

title: Matta 26:59
content: 59 Sai manyan firistoci da ’yan majalisa duka suka yi ta neman shaidar ƙarya a kan Yesu, don su sami dama su kashe shi.

title: Matta 26:60
content: 60 Amma ba su sami ko ɗaya ba, ko da yake masu shaidar ƙarya da yawa sun firfito. A ƙarshe, biyu suka zo gaba,

title: Matta 26:61
content: 61 suka furta cewa, “Wannan mutum ya ce, ‘Ina iya rushe haikalin Allah, in sāke gina shi cikin kwana uku.’ ”

title: Matta 26:62
content: 62 Sa’an nan babban firist ya miƙe tsaye, ya ce wa Yesu, “Ba ka da wata amsa? Shaidar da mutanen nan suke yi a kanka fa?”

title: Matta 26:63
content: 63 Amma Yesu ya yi shiru. Sai babban firist ya ce masa, “Na haɗa ka da Allah mai rai. Faɗa mana in kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah.”

title: Matta 26:64
content: 64 Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, haka yake yadda ka faɗa. Sai dai ina gaya muku duka, nan gaba, za ku ga Ɗan Mutum zaune a hannun dama na Mai Iko, yana kuma zuwa a kan gizagizan sama.”

title: Matta 26:65
content: 65 Sa’an nan babban firist ya yage tufafinsa ya ce, “Ya yi saɓo! Don me muke bukatar ƙarin shaidu? Ga shi, yanzu kun dai ji saɓon.

title: Matta 26:66
content: 66 Me kuka gani?” Suka amsa, suka ce, “Ya cancanci mutuwa.”

title: Matta 26:67
content: 67 Sai suka tottofa masa miyau a fuskarsa, suka kuma bubbuge shi da hannuwansu. Waɗansu kuma suka mammare shi

title: Matta 26:68
content: 68 suka ce, “Yi mana annabci, Kiristi. Wa ya buge ka?”

title: Matta 26:69
content: 69 To, Bitrus yana nan zaune a filin, sai wata yarinya baiwa, ta zo wurinsa. Ta ce, “Kai ma kana tare da Yesu mutumin Galili.”

title: Matta 26:70
content: 70 Amma ya yi mūsu a gabansu duka. Ya ce, “Ban san abin da kike magana ba.”

title: Matta 26:71
content: 71 Sa’an nan ya fito zuwa hanyar shiga, inda wata yarinya kuma ta gan shi, ta ce wa mutanen da suke can, “Wannan mutum ma yana tare da Yesu Banazare.”

title: Matta 26:72
content: 72 Ya sāke mūsu har da rantsuwa, yana cewa, “Ban ma san mutumin nan ba!”

title: Matta 26:73
content: 73 Bayan ɗan lokaci, sai na tsattsaye a wurin, suka hauro wurin Bitrus, suka ce, “Tabbatacce, kai ɗayansu ne, don harshen maganarka, ya tone ka.”

title: Matta 26:74
content: 74 Sai ya fara la’antar kansa, yana ta rantsuwa yana ce musu, “Ban ma san mutumin nan ba!” Nan da take, sai zakara ya yi cara.

title: Matta 26:75
content: 75 Sai Bitrus ya tuna da maganar da Yesu ya yi cewa, “Kafin zakara yă yi cara, za ka yi mūsun sani na sau uku.” Sai ya fita waje, ya yi ta kuka.

title: Matta 27:1
content: 1 Da wayewar gari, sai dukan manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane suka yanke shawara su kashe Yesu.

title: Matta 27:2
content: 2 Suka daure shi, suka tafi da shi, suka ba da shi ga gwamna Bilatus.

title: Matta 27:3
content: 3 Sa’ad da Yahuda, wanda ya bashe Yesu, ya ga an yanke wa Yesu hukuncin kisa, sai ya yi “da na sani.” Ya je mayar wa manyan firistoci da dattawan kuɗin azurfa talatin ɗin.

title: Matta 27:4
content: 4 Ya ce, “Na yi zunubi da na ci amanar marar laifi.” Suka ce masa, “Ina ruwanmu da wannan? Wannan dai ruwanka ne.”

title: Matta 27:5
content: 5 Sai Yahuda ya zubar da kuɗin a cikin haikalin ya tafi. Sa’an nan ya je ya rataye kansa.

title: Matta 27:6
content: 6 Manyan firistoci suka ɗauki kuɗin, suka ce, “Doka ta hana a sa kuɗin a cikin ma’aji, da yake kuɗin jini ne.”

title: Matta 27:7
content: 7 Saboda haka, sai suka yanke shawara su yi amfani da kuɗin suka sayi filin mai yin tukwane, saboda binne baƙi.

title: Matta 27:8
content: 8 Shi ya sa ake kiran filin, Filin Jini har yă zuwa yau.

title: Matta 27:9
content: 9 Sai abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Irmiya ya cika cewa, “Suka ɗauki azurfa talatin, kuɗin da mutanen Isra’ila suka sa a kansa,

title: Matta 27:10
content: 10 suka kuma yi amfani da su, suka sayi filin mai yin tukwane, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce ni.”

title: Matta 27:11
content: 11 Ana cikin haka, Yesu kuwa yana tsaye a gaban gwamna, sai gwamnan ya tambaye shi, “Kai ne Sarkin Yahudawa?” Yesu ya ce, “I, haka ne, kamar yadda ka faɗa.”

title: Matta 27:12
content: 12 Da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka zarge shi, bai ba da amsa ba.

title: Matta 27:13
content: 13 Sai Bilatus ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ba ka jin shaidar da suke kawowa a kanka?”

title: Matta 27:14
content: 14 Amma Yesu bai ce uffam game da ko ɗaya daga cikin zargin da suka yi masa ba. Har gwamna ya yi mamaki ƙwarai.

title: Matta 27:15
content: 15 A wannan irin Biki, gwamna yana da wata al’ada, ta sakin ɗan kurkuku guda wanda taron suka zaɓa.

title: Matta 27:16
content: 16 To, a wannan lokaci kuwa suna da wani shahararren ɗan kurkuku da ake kira Barabbas.

title: Matta 27:17
content: 17 Saboda haka da taron suka taru, sai Bilatus ya tambaye su ya ce, “Wane ne a cikinsu kuke so in sakar muku. Barabbas ko Yesu wanda ake kira Kiristi?”

title: Matta 27:18
content: 18 Don ya san saboda sonkai ne suka ba da Yesu a gare shi.

title: Matta 27:19
content: 19 Yayinda Bilatus yake zaune a kan kujerar shari’a, sai matarsa ta aika masa da wannan saƙo cewa, “Kada ka sa hannunka a kan marar laifin nan, domin na sha wahala ƙwarai, a cikin mafarki yau game da shi.”

title: Matta 27:20
content: 20 Amma manyan firistoci da dattawa suka shawo kan taron, su ce, a ba su Barabbas, amma a kashe Yesu.

title: Matta 27:21
content: 21 Gwamna ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Wane ne cikin biyun nan, kuke so in sakar muku?” Suka ce, “Barabbas.”

title: Matta 27:22
content: 22 Bilatus ya yi tambaya, “To, me zan yi da Yesu wanda ake kira Kiristi?” Duka suka ce, “A gicciye shi!”

title: Matta 27:23
content: 23 Bilatus ya ce, “Don me? Wane laifi ya yi?” Amma suka ƙara tā da ihu, suna cewa, “A gicciye shi!”

title: Matta 27:24
content: 24 Da Bilatus ya ga cewa ba ya kaiwa ko’ina, sai ma hargitsi ne yake so yă tashi, sai ya ɗibi ruwa, ya wanke hannuwansa a gaban taron ya ce, “Ni kam, ba ruwana da alhakin jinin mutumin nan. Wannan ruwanku ne!”

title: Matta 27:25
content: 25 Sai dukan mutane suka amsa, suka ce, “Bari alhakin jininsa yă zauna a kanmu da ’ya’yanmu!”

title: Matta 27:26
content: 26 Sai ya sakar musu Barabbas. Amma ya sa aka yi wa Yesu bulala, sa’an nan ya ba da shi a gicciye.

title: Matta 27:27
content: 27 Sai sojojin gwamna suka ɗauki Yesu suka kai shi Fadar mai mulki, sa’an nan suka tara dukan kamfanin sojoji kewaye da shi.

title: Matta 27:28
content: 28 Suka tuɓe shi, suka yafa masa wata jar riga.

title: Matta 27:29
content: 29 Suka kuma tuƙa wani rawanin ƙaya, suka sa masa a kā. Suka sa sanda a hannun damansa. Suka durƙusa a gabansa, suka yi masa ba’a, suna cewa, “Ranka yă daɗe sarkin Yahudawa!”

title: Matta 27:30
content: 30 Suka tattofa masa miyau, suka karɓe sandan, suka yi ta ƙwala masa shi a kai.

title: Matta 27:31
content: 31 Bayan sun yi masa ba’a, sai suka tuɓe masa rigar, suka sa masa nasa tufafin. Sai suka tafi da shi, domin su gicciye shi.

title: Matta 27:32
content: 32 Suna fitowa ke nan, sai suka sadu da wani mutumin Sairin, mai suna Siman. Sai suka tilasta shi ya ɗauki gicciyen.

title: Matta 27:33
content: 33 Sai suka iso wani wurin da ake kira Golgota (wanda yake nufin Wurin Ƙoƙon Kai).

title: Matta 27:34
content: 34 A can, suka ba shi ruwan inabi gauraye da wani abu mai ɗaci yă sha. Amma da ya ɗanɗana, sai ya ƙi sha.

title: Matta 27:35
content: 35 Bayan da suka gicciye shi, sai suka raba tufafinsa a tsakaninsu ta wurin jefa ƙuri’a.

title: Matta 27:36
content: 36 Sa’an nan suka zauna suna tsaronsa.

title: Matta 27:37
content: 37 Bisa da kansa kuwa, an kafa rubutun zargin da aka yi masa, da ya ce, Wannan shi ne Yesu Sarkin Yahudawa.

title: Matta 27:38
content: 38 An gicciye ’yan fashi biyu tare da shi, ɗaya a damansa, ɗaya kuma a hagunsa.

title: Matta 27:39
content: 39 Masu wucewa, suka zazzage shi, suna kaɗa kai,

title: Matta 27:40
content: 40 suna cewa, “Kai da za ka rushe haikali, ka kuma gina shi cikin kwana uku, ceci kanka mana! In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka sauka daga gicciyen!”

title: Matta 27:41
content: 41 Haka ma, manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki da kuma dattawa, suka yi ta yin masa ba’a, suna cewa,

title: Matta 27:42
content: 42 “Ya ceci waɗansu, amma ya kāsa ceton kansa! In shi ne Sarkin Isra’ila! To, yă sauko daga kan gicciyen nan, mu kuwa mu gaskata shi.

title: Matta 27:43
content: 43 Ya dogara ga Allah. Bari Allah yă cece shi yanzu, in yana sonsa, domin ya ce, ‘Ni Ɗan Allah ne.’ ”

title: Matta 27:44
content: 44 Haka ma, ’yan fashin da aka gicciye tare da shi, suka zazzage shi.

title: Matta 27:45
content: 45 Daga sa’a ta shida, har zuwa sa’a ta tara, duhu ya rufe ƙasa duka.

title: Matta 27:46
content: 46 Wajen sa’a ta tara, Yesu ya ɗaga murya da ƙarfi ya ce, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” (Wato, “Ya Allahna, ya Allahna, don me ka yashe ni?”).

title: Matta 27:47
content: 47 Sa’ad da waɗanda suke tsattsaye a wurin suka ji haka, sai suka ce, “Yana kiran Iliya.”

title: Matta 27:48
content: 48 Nan da nan, ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ruga, ya sami soso, ya jiƙa shi da ruwan tsami, ya sa a sanda, ya miƙa wa Yesu, yă sha.

title: Matta 27:49
content: 49 Sauran kuwa suka ce, “Ƙyale shi mu ga, ko Iliya zai zo yă cece shi.”

title: Matta 27:50
content: 50 Da Yesu ya sāke ɗaga murya da ƙarfi, sai ya saki ruhunsa.

title: Matta 27:51
content: 51 A daidai wannan lokaci, sai labulen haikali ya tsage gida biyu, daga sama har ƙasa. Ƙasa ta jijjiga, duwatsu kuma suka farfashe.

title: Matta 27:52
content: 52 Kaburbura suka bubbuɗe, jikunan tsarkaka da yawa kuwa cikin waɗanda da suka mutu, suka tashi.

title: Matta 27:53
content: 53 Suka firfito daga kaburbura, sa’an nan bayan tashin Yesu daga matattu, suka shiga birni mai tsarki, suka bayyana ga mutane da yawa.

title: Matta 27:54
content: 54 Da jarumin nan tare da waɗanda suke tsaron Yesu, suka ga girgizar ƙasa, da kuma abin da ya faru, sai tsoro ya kama su, suka kuma ce, “Gaskiya, wannan Ɗan Allah ne!”

title: Matta 27:55
content: 55 Akwai mata da yawa a can, suna kallo daga nesa. Sun bi Yesu tun daga Galili, suna masa hidima.

title: Matta 27:56
content: 56 A cikinsu, akwai Maryamu Magdalin, da Maryamu uwar Yaƙub da Yoses, da kuma uwar ’ya’yan Zebedi.

title: Matta 27:57
content: 57 Da yamma ta yi, sai ga wani mutum mai arziki daga Arimateya, sunansa Yusuf, wanda shi da kansa almajirin Yesu ne.

title: Matta 27:58
content: 58 Ya je wurin Bilatus, ya roƙe shi yă ba shi jikin Yesu. Sai Bilatus ya umarta a ba shi.

title: Matta 27:59
content: 59 Yusuf ya ɗauki jikin ya nannaɗe shi da zanen lilin mai tsabta.

title: Matta 27:60
content: 60 Sa’an nan ya sa shi a sabon kabarinsa, wanda ya haƙa a dutse. Bayan ya gungura wani babban dutse ya rufe bakin kabarin, sai ya tafi abinsa.

title: Matta 27:61
content: 61 Maryamu Magdalin da ɗayan Maryamun, suna zaune a wurin, ɗaura da kabarin.

title: Matta 27:62
content: 62 Kashegari, wato, bayan Ranar Shirye-shirye, sai manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa, suka je wurin Bilatus.

title: Matta 27:63
content: 63 Suka ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, mun tuna, mai ruɗin nan tun yana da rai ya ce, ‘Bayan kwana uku, zan tashi daga matattu.’

title: Matta 27:64
content: 64 Saboda haka, ka ba da umarni, a tsare kabarin sai rana ta uku ɗin. In ba haka ba, almajiransa za su iya zuwa su sace jikin, sa’an nan su faɗa wa mutane cewa, an tashe shi daga matattu. Ruɗin ƙarshen nan fa, sai yă fi na farkon muni.”

title: Matta 27:65
content: 65 Sai Bilatus ya ce, “Shi ke nan, ku ɗebi soja, ku je ku tsare kabarin iya ƙoƙarinku.”

title: Matta 27:66
content: 66 Sai suka je suka tsare kabarin ta wurin buga masa hatimi, suka kuma sa masu gadi.

title: Matta 28:1
content: 1 Bayan ranar Asabbaci, da sassafe, a ranar farko ta mako, Maryamu Magdalin tare da ɗaya Maryamun, suka je don su ga kabarin.

title: Matta 28:2
content: 2 Sai aka yi wata babbar girgizar ƙasa. Don wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya sauka daga sama, ya je kabarin, ya gungurar da dutsen, ya kuma zauna a kai.

title: Matta 28:3
content: 3 Kamanninsa yana kama da walƙiya, tufafinsa kuma fari fat kamar dusan ƙanƙara.

title: Matta 28:4
content: 4 Masu gadin kabarin kuma suka ji tsoro ƙwarai, suka yi rawan jiki, suka zama kamar matattu.

title: Matta 28:5
content: 5 Mala’ikan ya ce wa matan, “Kada ku ji tsoro, domin na san cewa kuna neman Yesu wanda aka gicciye ne.

title: Matta 28:6
content: 6 Ai, ba ya nan, ya tashi kamar yadda ya faɗa. Ku zo ku ga inda ya kwanta.

title: Matta 28:7
content: 7 Sai ku tafi da sauri ku gaya wa almajiransa cewa, ‘Ya tashi daga matattu, ya kuma ya sha gabanku zuwa Galili. Can za ku gan shi.’ Ga shi na faɗa muku.”

title: Matta 28:8
content: 8 Sai matan suka bar kabarin da hanzari, da tsoro, sai dai cike da farin ciki, suka tafi a guje don su gaya wa almajiransa.

title: Matta 28:9
content: 9 Kwaram, sai ga Yesu ya gamu da su ya ce, “Gaisuwa.” Sai suka zo kusa da shi, suka rungumi ƙafafunsa, suka yi masa sujada.

title: Matta 28:10
content: 10 Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Kada ku ji tsoro, ku tafi ku gaya wa ’yan’uwana, su tafi Galili. A can za su gan ni.”

title: Matta 28:11
content: 11 Yayinda matan nan suna cikin tafiya, sai waɗansu daga cikin masu gadin suka shiga gari, suka ba wa manyan firistoci labarin duk abin da ya faru.

title: Matta 28:12
content: 12 Da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka taru, sai suka ƙulla wata dabara, suka ba wa sojojin kuɗi mai yawa.

title: Matta 28:13
content: 13 Suka ce musu, “Ku, za ku ce, ‘Almajiransa ne sun zo da dare suka sace shi, lokacin da muke barci.’

title: Matta 28:14
content: 14 In wannan labari ya kai kunnen gwamna, za mu lallashe shi, mu kuma kāre ku daga duk wata wahala.”

title: Matta 28:15
content: 15 Sai sojojin suka karɓi kuɗin, suka kuma yi kamar yadda aka umarce su. Wannan labarin kuwa shi ne ake bazawa ko’ina a cikin Yahudawa, har yă zuwa yau.

title: Matta 28:16
content: 16 Sa’an nan almajiransa goma sha ɗaya, suka tafi Galili, suka je dutsen da Yesu ya gaya musu.

title: Matta 28:17
content: 17 Da suka gan shi, sai suka yi masa sujada, amma waɗansu suka yi shakka.

title: Matta 28:18
content: 18 Sai Yesu ya zo wurinsu ya ce, “An ba ni dukan iko a sama da kuma ƙasa.

title: Matta 28:19
content: 19 Saboda haka ku tafi, ku mai da dukan al’umman duniya su zama almajiraina, kuna yi musu baftisma a cikin sunan Uba, da na Ɗa, da na Ruhu Mai Tsarki,

title: Matta 28:20
content: 20 kuna kuma koya musu, su yi biyayya da duk abin da na umarce ku, kuma tabbatacce, ina tare da ku kullum, har ƙarshen zamani.”
